items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t) <-> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t) <-> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P {f x | x :e t})

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall t c= A, (exists s c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t a /\ P s) <-> exists s c= A, s c= t /\ (P s \/ P (SetAdjoin s a))

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall t u c= A, (exists s c= A, s c= t :\/: u /\ P s) <-> exists t' u' c= A, t' c= t /\ (u' c= u /\ P (t' :\/: u'))

items.name: EXISTS_SUM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists z :e B :+: A, P z) <-> (exists x :e B, P (Inj0 x)) \/ exists x :e A, P (Inj1 x)

items.name: EXISTS_SWAP_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: B :^: A, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, f x y :e C) /\ P (fun a :e A => fun b :e B => f b a)

items.name: EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> P (choose_in A P)

items.name: EXISTS_TRIPLED_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A :*: (B :*: C), P (x 0) (x 1 0) (x 1 1)) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, exists z :e C, P x y z

items.name: EXISTS_UNCURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: B :^: A, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) /\ P (fun a :e A => fun b :e B => f (a,b))

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> exists x :e A, forall y :e A, P y <-> x = y

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) /\ forall x y :e A, P x /\ P y -> x = y

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, exists x :e A, x = a /\ forall y :e A, y = a -> y = x

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) /\ forall x x' :e A, P x /\ P x' -> x = x'

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists s c= A, P s /\ forall y c= A, P y -> y = s) <-> Union {s :e Power A | P s} = {x :e A | forall Y :e {s :e Power A | P s}, x :e Y}

items.name: EXISTS_UNPAIR_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists f :e B :^: A, exists g :e C :^: A, P f g) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B :*: C) /\ P (fun x :e A => h x 0) (fun x :e A => h x 1)

items.name: EXISTS_UNPAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) <-> exists z :e A :*: B, P (z 0) (z 1)

items.name: EXP
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, m ^ 0 = 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, m ^ ordsucc n = m * m ^ n

items.name: EXP_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n ^ 1 = n

items.name: EXP_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n ^ 2 = n * n

items.name: EXP_2_NE_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ 2 ^ n = 0

items.name: EXP_ADD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m ^ (n + p) = m ^ n * m ^ p

items.name: EXP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m ^ n = 0 <-> m = 0 /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: EXP_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x n :e omega, x ^ n = 1 <-> x = 1 \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_EXP
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, (x ^ m) ^ n = x ^ (m * n)

items.name: EXP_INDEX_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ prime_index p n) n

items.name: EXP_ITER
items.statement: forall x n :e omega, x ^ n = iter_fun n (fun y:set => x * y) 1

items.name: EXP_LT_0
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, 0 < x ^ n <-> ~ x = 0 \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_EQ
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n = y ^ n <-> x = y \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_LE
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n <= y ^ n <-> x <= y \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x <= y -> x ^ n <= y ^ n

items.name: EXP_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n < y ^ n <-> x < y /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_LT_IMP
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x < y /\ ~ n = 0 -> x ^ n < y ^ n

items.name: EXP_MULT
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m ^ (n * p) = (m ^ n) ^ p

items.name: EXP_MULT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n p k :e omega, ~ m = 0 /\ m ^ k * n = p ^ k -> exists q :e omega, n = q ^ k

items.name: EXP_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e omega, forall n:set -> set, (forall x :e A, n x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> m ^ finsum s n = finprod s (fun i:set => m ^ n i)

items.name: EXP_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 ^ n = 1

items.name: EXP_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

items.name: EXTEND_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, woset_on A l -> (x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => l x0 y /\ l y a) <-> l x a)

items.name: EXTEND_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, woset_on A l /\ a :e fld_on A l -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => l x y /\ l y a) l

items.name: EXTEND_LINSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, woset_on A l /\ a :e fld_on A l -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => linseg_rel l a x y \/ y = a /\ (x :e fld_on A (linseg_rel l a) \/ x = a)) l

items.name: EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s = t <-> forall x :e A, x :e s <-> x :e t

items.name: EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x :e B :^: A, (forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> x :e {f :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> f x0 = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e B :^: A, (forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e Empty -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> x :e SetAdjoin Empty (fun x0 :e A => choose_in B (fun x:set => True))

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f g :e B :^: A, f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x0 x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ (g :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x0 x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)) -> f = g

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, ~ x :e A -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: EX_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ P x -> Q x) /\ seq_ex P l -> seq_ex Q l

items.name: EX_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_ex P (seq_map f l) <-> seq_ex (fun x:set => P (f x)) l

items.name: EX_MEM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (exists x :e A, P x /\ seq_mem x l) <-> seq_ex P l

items.name: FACT
items.statement: factorial 0 = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, factorial (ordsucc n) = ordsucc n * factorial n

items.name: FACTORIZATION_INDEX
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ 2 <= p -> exists k :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ k) n /\ forall l :e omega, k < l -> ~ divides_nat (p ^ l) n

items.name: FACT_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 <= factorial n

items.name: FACT_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 < factorial n

items.name: FACT_MONO
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> factorial m <= factorial n

items.name: FACT_NZ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ factorial n = 0

items.name: FCONS
items.error: internal constant FCONS (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: FCONS_UNDO
items.error: internal constant FCONS (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: FERMAT_LITTLE
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, gcd_int a n = 1 -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ totient n + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: FERMAT_LITTLE_PRIME
items.statement: forall a p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ gcd_int a p = 1 -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ minus_nat p 1 + p * q1 = 1 + p * q2

items.name: FILTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_filter P seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_filter P (seq_cons h t) = if P h then seq_cons h (seq_filter P t) else seq_filter P t

items.name: FILTER_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_filter P (seq_append l1 l2) = seq_append (seq_filter P l1) (seq_filter P l2)

items.name: FILTER_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_filter P (seq_map f l) = seq_map f (seq_filter (fun x:set => P (f x)) l)

items.name: FINITE_1
items.statement: finite 1

items.name: FINITE_BOOL
items.statement: finite 2

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= n -> finite {f x | x :e s} /\ finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} <= n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, s c= t /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= m /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite (s :\/: t) /\ finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) <= m + n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x) /\ finite_cardinality (t x) <= n) /\ (finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= m) -> finite (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) /\ finite_cardinality (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) <= m * n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> atleastp s omega /\ ~ equip s omega

items.name: FINITE_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> finite {x :e A | P i x}) -> finite {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)}

items.name: FINITE_CART_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> finite A -> finite (A :^: idx N)

items.name: FINITE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a c= A, finite a <-> a = Empty \/ exists x :e A, exists s c= A, a = SetAdjoin s x /\ finite s

items.name: FINITE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite 1 /\ (finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) /\ finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)))

items.name: FINITE_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :*: t)

items.name: FINITE_CROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: FINITE_CROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (finite (A :*: B) <-> finite A /\ finite B)

items.name: FINITE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, finite (s :\: {x}) <-> finite s

items.name: FINITE_DELETE_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, finite s -> finite (s :\: {x})

items.name: FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite s -> finite (s :\: t)

items.name: FINITE_DIFF_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1) = idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1)

items.name: FINITE_DIVISORS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finite {d :e omega | divides_nat d n}

items.name: FINITE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite Empty

items.name: FINITE_EXP_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall p n :e omega, 2 <= p -> finite {j :e omega | P j /\ p ^ j <= n}

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite (idx A)

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, finite t /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> finite {x :e A | f x = y}) -> finite {x :e A | f x :e t}

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_PREIMAGE_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y}) -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, finite s -> (finite (Union s) <-> forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t)

items.name: FINITE_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, finite (fld_on A l) <-> finite (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e A, l x y})

items.name: FINITE_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = d}

items.name: FINITE_FUNSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> finite A /\ finite B -> finite (B :^: A)

items.name: FINITE_HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> equip s (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {f x | x :e s} <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t})

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_EQ_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {f x | x :e s} <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} /\ forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_EXPAND
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {y :e B | exists x :e A, x :e s /\ y = f x}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (finite t /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> g x = g y)) -> finite {g x | x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, idx A = idx A

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ finite {f x | x :e s} -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ infinite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = f a}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall A0 c= B, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ finite A0 -> finite {x :e A | f x :e A0}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (finite {f x | x :e s} <-> finite s)

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INJ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall A0 c= B, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ finite A0 -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e A0}

items.name: FINITE_IMP_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> countable s

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex A /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex A)) -> (i = j <-> i = j)

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_INRANGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, exists k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ forall x :e A :^: idx N, x i = x k)

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_INRANGE_2
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, exists k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((forall x :e A :^: idx N, x i = x k) /\ forall y :e B :^: idx N, y i = y k))

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_NUMBERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> exists k c= omega, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ f i = f j) -> i = j) /\ (finite k /\ s = {f x | x :e k}))

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, i :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s) /\ (j :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s) /\ f i = f j) -> i = j) /\ s = {f x | x :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s)})

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_WORKS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i :e idx A, exists n :e omega, 1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex A /\ n = i) /\ forall y :e omega, 1 <= y /\ (y <= dimindex A /\ y = i) -> y = n

items.name: FINITE_INDICES
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall p n :e omega, 2 <= p /\ ~ n = 0 -> finite {j :e omega | P j /\ divides_nat (p ^ j) n}

items.name: FINITE_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall FINITE':set -> prop, FINITE' Empty /\ (forall x :e A, forall s c= A, FINITE' s -> FINITE' (SetAdjoin s x)) -> forall a c= A, finite a -> FINITE' a

items.name: FINITE_INDUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall s c= A, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ (P (s :\: {x}) -> P s)) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> P s

items.name: FINITE_INDUCT_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall x :e A, forall s c= A, P s /\ (~ x :e s /\ finite s) -> P (SetAdjoin s x)) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> P s

items.name: FINITE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, finite (SetAdjoin s x) <-> finite s

items.name: FINITE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s \/ finite t -> finite (s :/\: t)

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ Union u = A :\: s

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x0) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: FINITE_INTSEG
items.statement: forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | x :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x <= b)}

items.name: FINITE_INT_SEG
items.statement: (forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l <= x /\ x <= r}) /\ ((forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l <= x /\ x < r}) /\ ((forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l < x /\ x <= r}) /\ forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l < x /\ x < r}))

items.name: FINITE_NUMBER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip {m :e omega | 0 < m /\ m < n} (minus_nat n 1)

items.name: FINITE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, finite {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FINITE_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite {m :e omega | m <= n}

items.name: FINITE_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite {m :e omega | m < n}

items.name: FINITE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: FINITE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, finite (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: FINITE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: FINITE_POWERSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite {t :e Power A | t c= s} <-> finite s

items.name: FINITE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: FINITE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x)) -> finite (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t x})

items.name: FINITE_PROD_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B) = idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B)

items.name: FINITE_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | a < x}) /\ ((forall a :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | a <= x}) /\ ((forall b :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | x < b}) /\ ((forall b :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | x <= b}) /\ ((forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a < x /\ x < b} <-> b <= a) /\ ((forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a <= x /\ x < b} <-> b <= a) /\ ((forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a < x /\ x <= b} <-> b <= a) /\ forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a <= x /\ x <= b} <-> b <= a))))))

items.name: FINITE_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, (forall x y :e A, forall s :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) -> set_foldr f Empty b = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> set_foldr f (SetAdjoin s x) b = if x :e s then set_foldr f s b else f x (set_foldr f s b)

items.name: FINITE_RECURSION_DELETE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, (forall x y :e A, forall s :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) -> set_foldr f Empty b = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> set_foldr f s b = if x :e s then f x (set_foldr f (s :\: {x}) b) else set_foldr f (s :\: {x}) b

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, finite s -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x}

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finite {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ {x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s}

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, finite {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ equip t n} <-> finite s \/ n = 0

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ P t}

items.name: FINITE_RULES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite Empty /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite (SetAdjoin s x)

items.name: FINITE_SET_OF_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, finite (seq_set l)

items.name: FINITE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, finite {a}

items.name: FINITE_SPECIAL_DIVISORS
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finite {d :e omega | P d /\ divides_nat d n}

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ s c= t -> finite s

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} <-> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ t = {f x | x :e s'})

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ t c= {f x | x :e s'})

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s <-> exists n :e omega, s c= {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power A, finite f' /\ (f' c= f /\ s c= Union f')

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ (s c= Union f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> t c= u \/ u c= t))) -> exists t c= A, t :e f /\ s c= t

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ f = Empty /\ ((forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> t c= u \/ u c= t) /\ finite s) -> (s c= Union f <-> exists t c= A, t :e f /\ s c= t)

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_DIRECTED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ f = Empty /\ ((forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> exists v c= A, v :e f /\ (t c= v /\ u c= v)) /\ finite s) -> (s c= Union f <-> exists t c= A, t :e f /\ s c= t)

items.name: FINITE_SUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B) = idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)

items.name: FINITE_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op}

items.name: FINITE_SUPPORT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, finite {x :e s | (if x = a then f x else neutral_of B op) <> neutral_of B op}

items.name: FINITE_TRANSITIVITY_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, ~ R0 x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ R0 x y))) -> s = Empty

items.name: FINITE_TYBIT0

items.name: FINITE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite (s :\/: t) <-> finite s /\ finite t

items.name: FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, finite (Union s) <-> finite s /\ forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :\/: t)

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A :\: s

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x0) /\ Union u = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :\/: t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = Union u

items.name: FINITE_UNIV_PAIR
items.statement: forall A:set, finite (A :*: A) <-> finite A

items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall s :e A, P s -> exists a :e B, exists n :e C, R0 s a n) /\ (forall n1 n2 :e C, forall s :e A, forall a1 a2 :e B, R0 s a1 n1 /\ R0 s a2 n2 -> a1 = a2 /\ n1 = n2) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall s :e A, forall a :e B, P s -> ((exists n :e C, R0 s a n) <-> f s = a)

items.name: FLD_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, fld_on A R0 = Empty <-> forall x y :e A, R0 x y <-> False

items.name: FLD_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= K, qoset_on A l -> fld_on (A :^: K) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (fun x :e A :^: K => {y :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, i :e s -> l (i i) (y i)}) x) = {x :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, i :e s -> x i :e fld_on A l}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall P:set -> prop, x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => P x0 /\ (P y /\ l x0 y)) <-> P x /\ x :e fld_on A l

items.name: FLD_RESTRICTED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, x :e fld_on (Power A) (fun x0:set => fun y:set => P x0 /\ (P y /\ x0 c= y)) <-> P x

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, poset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, toset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, woset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_WQOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, wqoset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, l x y -> r x y) -> fld_on A l c= fld_on A r

items.name: FLD_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => l x0 y \/ y = a /\ (x0 :e fld_on A l \/ x0 = a)) <-> x :e fld_on A l \/ x = a

items.name: FLD_TRIVIAL

items.name: FLOOR

items.name: FLOOR_DIV_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> floor_R (n :/: m) = div_nat n m

items.name: FLOOR_DOUBLE
items.statement: forall u :e R, 2 * floor_R u <= floor_R (2 * u) /\ floor_R (2 * u) <= 2 * floor_R u + 1

items.name: FLOOR_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, floor_R x = 0 <-> 0 <= x /\ x < 1

items.name: FLOOR_FRAC
items.statement: forall x :e R, floor_R x :e int /\ (0 <= x + - floor_R x /\ (x + - floor_R x < 1 /\ x = floor_R x + x + - floor_R x))

items.name: FLOOR_MONO
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x <= y -> floor_R x <= floor_R y

items.name: FLOOR_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, floor_R n = n

items.name: FLOOR_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> exists n :e omega, floor_R x = n

items.name: FLOOR_POS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= floor_R x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: FLOOR_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall x a :e R, a :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x < a + 1) <-> floor_R x = a

items.name: FNIL
items.error: internal constant FNIL (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: FORALL_2
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= 2 -> P i) <-> P 1 /\ P 2

items.name: FORALL_ALL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq B, (forall x :e A, seq_all (P x) l) <-> seq_all (fun s:set => forall x :e A, P x s) l

items.name: FORALL_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x /\ Q x) <-> (forall x :e A, P x) /\ forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: FORALL_BOOL_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall b:prop, P (if b then 1 else 0)) <-> P (if True then 1 else 0) /\ P (if False then 1 else 0)

items.name: FORALL_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, (forall z :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ i :e k -> P i (z i)) <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ x :e s i -> P i x

items.name: FORALL_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, ~ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty -> ((forall i :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ x :e s i -> P i x) <-> forall z :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ i :e k -> P i (z i))

items.name: FORALL_COUNTABLE_AS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall d c= A, countable d -> P d) <-> P Empty /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> P {f x | x :e omega}

items.name: FORALL_COUNTABLE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, countable t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, countable t /\ t c= s -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_COUNTABLE_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, countable t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, countable t /\ (t c= s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_CURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f :e C :^: (A :*: B), P f) <-> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> P (fun p :e A :*: B => f (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: FORALL_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x) <-> forall x :e A, P x <-> True

items.name: FORALL_FINITE_INDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall k :e idx N, P k) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i

items.name: FORALL_FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, finite t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, finite t /\ t c= s -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, finite t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_INTEGER
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, P n) /\ (forall x :e R, P x -> P (- x)) -> forall x :e R, x :e int -> P x

items.name: FORALL_INTERSECTION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q R0:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> R0 s) <-> forall t c= Power A, P t /\ (forall c c= A, c :e t -> Q c) -> R0 {x :e A | forall Y :e t, x :e Y}

items.name: FORALL_INT_CASES
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e int, P x) <-> (forall n :e omega, P n) /\ forall n :e omega, P (- n)

items.name: FORALL_IN_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, x :e Empty -> P x) <-> True) /\ forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e SetAdjoin s a -> P x) <-> P a /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> P x

items.name: FORALL_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall z :e A :*: B, z :e s :*: t -> P z) <-> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t -> P (x,y)

items.name: FORALL_IN_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall P Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall z :e B, z :e {f x | x :e A, P x} -> Q z) <-> forall x :e A, P x -> Q (f x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> ((forall z :e C, z :e (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}) -> Q z) <-> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> Q (f x y))) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e D) -> ((forall z :e D, z :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, {f w x y | y :e C, P w x y}) -> Q z) <-> forall w :e A, forall x :e B, forall y :e C, P w x y -> Q (f w x y))) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, forall w :e D, f x y z w :e E) -> ((forall z :e E, z :e (\/_ v :e A, \/_ w :e B, \/_ x :e C, {f v w x y | y :e D, P v w x y}) -> Q z) <-> forall v :e A, forall w :e B, forall x :e C, forall y :e D, P v w x y -> Q (f v w x y))))

items.name: FORALL_IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall y :e B, y :e {f x | x :e s} -> P y) <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> P (f x)

items.name: FORALL_IN_IMAGE_2
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e B, x :e {f x | x :e s} /\ y :e {f x | x :e s} -> P x y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> P (f x) (f y)

items.name: FORALL_IN_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e SetAdjoin s a -> P x) <-> P a /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> P x

items.name: FORALL_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall P:set -> prop, (forall z :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), z :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) -> P z) <-> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> P (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: FORALL_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s :\/: t -> P x) <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> P x) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> P x

items.name: FORALL_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= Power A, (forall x :e A, x :e Union s -> P x) <-> forall t c= A, forall x :e A, t :e s /\ x :e t -> P x

items.name: FORALL_LT_MOD_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (forall a :e omega, a < n -> P a) <-> n = 0 \/ forall a :e omega, P (mod_nat a n)

items.name: FORALL_MOD_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> ((forall a :e omega, P (mod_nat a n)) <-> forall a :e omega, a < n -> P a)

items.name: FORALL_NOT_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, ~ P x) <-> ~ exists x :e A, P x

items.name: FORALL_ONE_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e 1, P x) <-> P 0

items.name: FORALL_OPTION_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e 1 :+: A, P x) <-> P (Inj0 0) /\ forall a :e A, P (Inj1 a)

items.name: FORALL_PAIRED_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A :*: B, P (x 0) (x 1)) <-> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y

items.name: FORALL_PAIR_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f :e (B :*: C) :^: A, P f) <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e C) -> P (fun a :e A => (g a,h a))

items.name: FORALL_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall p :e A :*: B, P p) <-> forall p1 :e A, forall p2 :e B, P (p1,p2)

items.name: FORALL_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall p :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), P p) <-> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, P (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: FORALL_PRIME_INDEX
items.statement: (forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, P (prime_index p x)) <-> forall k :e omega, P k) /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, ~ x = 0 -> P (prime_index p x)) <-> forall k :e omega, P k

items.name: FORALL_SIMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:prop, (forall x :e A, t) <-> t

items.name: FORALL_SMALL_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall t c= B, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ t c= {f x | x :e s}) -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ t c= s) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SMALL_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall t c= B, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ t c= {f x | x :e s}) -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ (t c= s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, t c= s -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, t c= s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall t c= A, (forall s c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t a -> P s) <-> forall s c= A, s c= t -> P s /\ P (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall t u c= A, (forall s c= A, s c= t :\/: u -> P s) <-> forall t' u' c= A, t' c= t /\ u' c= u -> P (t' :\/: u')

items.name: FORALL_SUM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall z :e B :+: A, P z) <-> (forall x :e B, P (Inj0 x)) /\ forall x :e A, P (Inj1 x)

items.name: FORALL_TRIPLED_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), P (x 0) (x 1 0) (x 1 1)) <-> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, P x y z

items.name: FORALL_UNCURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f :e C :^: B :^: A, P f) <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> P (fun a :e A => fun b :e B => f (a,b))

items.name: FORALL_UNION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q R0:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) -> R0 s) <-> forall t c= Power A, P t /\ (forall c c= A, c :e t -> Q c) -> R0 (Union t)

items.name: FORALL_UNPAIR_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: A, P f g) <-> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B :*: C) -> P (fun x :e A => h x 0) (fun x :e A => h x 1)

items.name: FORALL_UNPAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y) <-> forall z :e A :*: B, P (z 0) (z 1)

items.name: FORALL_UNWIND_THM1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (forall x :e A, a = x -> P x) <-> P a

items.name: FORALL_UNWIND_THM2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (forall x :e A, x = a -> P x) <-> P a

items.name: FRAC_DIV_MOD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> m :/: n + - floor_R (m :/: n) = mod_nat m n :/: n

items.name: FRAC_FLOOR
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - floor_R x = x + - floor_R x

items.name: FRAC_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x + - floor_R (- x) = if x :e int then 0 else 1 + - (x + - floor_R x)

items.name: FRAC_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n + - floor_R n = 0

items.name: FRAC_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall x a :e R, x + - a :e int /\ (0 <= a /\ a < 1) <-> x + - floor_R x = a

items.name: FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x = x

items.name: FSTCART_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> fstcart M x i = x i

items.name: FSTCART_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, fstcart M (pastecart M N x y) = x

items.name: FST_DEF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall p :e A :*: B, p 0 = choose_in A (fun x:set => exists y :e B, p = (x,y))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> ((forall x y :e A, g x = g y -> f x = f y) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e C, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, f x = h (g x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_LEFT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> ((forall x y :e A, P x /\ (P y /\ g x = g y) -> f x = f y) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e C, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, P x -> f x = h (g x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, exists y :e B, g y = f x) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, f x = g (h x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_RIGHT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, P x -> exists y :e B, g y = f x) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, P x -> f x = g (h x))

items.name: FUN_EQ_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, f x = g x) <-> forall x :e A, f x = g x)

items.name: FUN_IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e {f x | x :e s}

items.name: F_DEF
items.statement: False <-> forall p:prop, p

items.name: GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, divides_nat (gcd_int a b) a /\ divides_nat (gcd_int a b) b /\ forall e0 :e omega, divides_nat e0 a /\ divides_nat e0 b -> divides_nat e0 (gcd_int a b)

items.name: GCD_0
items.statement: (forall a :e omega, gcd_int 0 a = a) /\ forall a :e omega, gcd_int a 0 = a

items.name: GCD_1
items.statement: (forall a :e omega, gcd_int 1 a = 1) /\ forall a :e omega, gcd_int a 1 = 1

items.name: GCD_2_CASES
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, gcd_int 2 n = if even_nat n then 2 else 1) /\ forall n :e omega, gcd_int n 2 = if even_nat n then 2 else 1

items.name: GCD_ADD
items.statement: (forall a b :e omega, gcd_int (a + b) b = gcd_int a b) /\ ((forall a b :e omega, gcd_int (b + a) b = gcd_int a b) /\ ((forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a (a + b) = gcd_int a b) /\ forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a (b + a) = gcd_int a b))

items.name: GCD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a (gcd_int b c) = gcd_int (gcd_int a b) c

items.name: GCD_BEZOUT
items.statement: forall a b d :e omega, (exists x y :e omega, minus_nat (a * x) (b * y) = d \/ minus_nat (b * x) (a * y) = d) <-> divides_nat (gcd_int a b) d

items.name: GCD_BEZOUT_SUM
items.statement: forall a b d x y :e omega, a * x + b * y = d -> divides_nat (gcd_int a b) d

items.name: GCD_COPRIME
items.statement: forall a b a' b' :e omega, ~ gcd_int a b = 0 /\ (a = a' * gcd_int a b /\ b = b' * gcd_int a b) -> gcd_int a' b' = 1

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_DIVIDES_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 /\ divides_nat a c -> gcd_int (a * b) c = a * gcd_int b c

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_DIVIDES_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int b c = 1 /\ divides_nat b a -> gcd_int a (b * c) = b * gcd_int a c

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_EXISTS
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, exists a' b' :e omega, a = a' * gcd_int a b /\ (b = b' * gcd_int a b /\ gcd_int a' b' = 1)

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int a c * gcd_int b c

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int c (a * b) = gcd_int c a * gcd_int c b

items.name: GCD_EQ
items.statement: forall x y u v :e omega, (forall d :e omega, divides_nat d x /\ divides_nat d y <-> divides_nat d u /\ divides_nat d v) -> gcd_int x y = gcd_int u v

items.name: GCD_EXP
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, gcd_int (a ^ n) (b ^ n) = gcd_int a b ^ n

items.name: GCD_LCM_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a (lcm_int b c) = lcm_int (gcd_int a b) (gcd_int a c)

items.name: GCD_LE
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= m <-> m = 0 -> n = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= n <-> n = 0 -> m = 0

items.name: GCD_LE_MAX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= if m <= n then n else m

items.name: GCD_LE_MIN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (m = 0 <-> n = 0) -> gcd_int m n <= if m <= n then m else n

items.name: GCD_LE_MIN_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= (if m <= n then m else n) <-> (m = 0 <-> n = 0)

items.name: GCD_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int (c * a) (c * b) = c * gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_MULTIPLE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int b (a * b) = b

items.name: GCD_MUL_COPRIME
items.statement: (forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int a (b * c) = gcd_int a c) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a c = 1 -> gcd_int a (b * c) = gcd_int a b) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int b c = 1 -> gcd_int a (b * c) = gcd_int a b * gcd_int a c) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a c = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int b c) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int b c = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int a c) /\ forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int a c * gcd_int b c))))

items.name: GCD_ONE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int a b = 1

items.name: GCD_PRIME_CASES
items.statement: (forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> gcd_int p n = if divides_nat p n then p else 1) /\ forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> gcd_int n p = if divides_nat p n then p else 1

items.name: GCD_REFL
items.statement: forall a :e omega, gcd_int a a = a

items.name: GCD_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int (a * c) (b * c) = c * gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_SUB
items.statement: (forall a b :e omega, b <= a -> gcd_int (minus_nat a b) b = gcd_int a b) /\ forall a b :e omega, a <= b -> gcd_int a (minus_nat b a) = gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_SYM
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = gcd_int b a

items.name: GCD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b /\ (forall e0 :e omega, divides_nat e0 a /\ divides_nat e0 b -> divides_nat e0 d) <-> d = gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_ZERO
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 0 <-> a = 0 /\ b = 0

items.name: GE
items.statement: forall n m :e omega, n <= m <-> n <= m

items.name: GE_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp t s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ y = f x

items.name: GT
items.statement: forall n m :e omega, n < m <-> n < m

items.name: HALF_DOUBLE
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, div_nat (2 * n) 2 = n) /\ forall n :e omega, div_nat (n * 2) 2 = n

items.name: HAS_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_glb s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e s -> l <= x) /\ forall c :e R, l < c -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c)

items.name: HAS_INF_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l c :e R, is_glb s l /\ l < c -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c

items.name: HAS_INF_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_glb s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ inf s = l)

items.name: HAS_INF_LBOUND
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b x :e R, is_glb s b /\ x :e s -> b <= x

items.name: HAS_INF_LE
items.statement: forall s t c= R, forall l m :e R, is_glb s l /\ (is_glb t m /\ (forall y :e R, y :e t -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x <= y)) -> l <= m

items.name: HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n <-> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s = n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s 0 <-> s = Empty

items.name: HAS_SIZE_1
items.statement: equip 1 1

items.name: HAS_SIZE_2
items.statement: equip (idx_n 2) 2

items.name: HAS_SIZE_3
items.statement: equip (idx_n 3) 3

items.name: HAS_SIZE_4
items.statement: equip (idx_n 4) 4

items.name: HAS_SIZE_BOOL
items.statement: equip 2 2

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> finite_cardinality s = n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e omega) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> equip {x :e A | P i x} (m i)) -> equip {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)} (finprod (idx N) m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CART_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e omega, equip A m -> equip (A :^: idx N) (m ^ dimindex N)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (equip s 0 <-> s = Empty) /\ (equip s (ordsucc n) <-> exists a :e A, exists t c= A, equip t n /\ (~ a :e t /\ s = SetAdjoin t a))

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip (s :*: t) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ (equip t n /\ t c= s) -> equip (s :\: t) (minus_nat m n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> equip (idx A) (dimindex A)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e B, forall n :e omega, forall t c= B, forall m :e omega, forall s c= A, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = d} (n ^ m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FUNSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, equip A m /\ equip B n -> equip (B :^: A) (n ^ m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ equip s n -> equip {f x | x :e s} n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (equip {f x | x :e s} n <-> equip s n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ equip {x :e A | x :e s /\ P (f x)} n)))) -> equip {x :e B | x :e t /\ P x} n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INDEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m < n -> f m :e s) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists m :e omega, m < n /\ f m = x /\ forall y :e omega, y < n /\ f y = x -> y = m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INTSEG_INT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a :e int /\ b :e int -> equip {x :e R | x :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x <= b)} (if b < a then 0 else if (if (b + - a) + 1 :e int then (b + - a) + 1 else 0) :e omega then if (b + - a) + 1 :e int then (b + - a) + 1 else 0 else 0)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INTSEG_NUM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, equip {x :e R | x :e int /\ (m <= x /\ x <= n)} (minus_nat (n + 1) m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, equip {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (minus_nat (n + 1) m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip (idx_n n) n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip {m :e omega | m <= n} (n + 1)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip {m :e omega | m < n} n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s} (2 ^ n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e omega, forall t c= B, forall n :e omega, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e omega, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall n :e omega, equip s m /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> equip (t x) n) -> equip (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t x}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_RESTRICTED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n m :e omega, forall s c= A, equip s n -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ equip t m} (binomial_coefficient n m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_SET_OF_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, equip (seq_set l) (seq_len l) <-> seq_pairwise (fun x:set => fun y:set => ~ x = y) l

items.name: HAS_SIZE_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s (ordsucc n) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ forall a :e A, a :e s -> equip (s :\: {a}) n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_TYBIT0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) (2 * dimindex A)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_TYBIT1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)) (2 * dimindex A + 1)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ (equip t n /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> equip (s :\/: t) (m + n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> equip (t x) n) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> t x :/\: t y = Empty)) -> equip (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_lub s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= l) /\ forall c :e R, c < l -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ c < x)

items.name: HAS_SUP_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l c :e R, is_lub s l /\ c < l -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ c < x

items.name: HAS_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s t c= R, forall l m :e R, is_lub s l /\ (is_lub t m /\ (forall y :e R, y :e t -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ y <= x)) -> m <= l

items.name: HAS_SUP_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_lub s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ sup s = l)

items.name: HAS_SUP_UBOUND
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b x :e R, is_lub s b /\ x :e s -> x <= b

items.name: HD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_hd (seq_cons h t) = h

items.name: HD_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_hd (seq_append l m) = if l = seq_nil then seq_hd m else seq_hd l

items.name: HD_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_hd (seq_rev l) = seq_last l

items.name: HP

items.name: IMAGE
