items.name: IMAGE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, {f x | x :e Empty} = Empty /\ {f x0 | x0 :e SetAdjoin s x} = SetAdjoin {f x | x :e s} (f x)

items.name: IMAGE_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall c :e B, {c | x :e s} = if s = Empty then Empty else {c}

items.name: IMAGE_DELETE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = f a -> x = a) -> {f x | x :e s :\: {a}} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f a}

items.name: IMAGE_DELETE_INJ_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ a :e s -> {f x | x :e s :\: {a}} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f a}

items.name: IMAGE_DIFF_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e s :\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_DIFF_INJ_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ t c= s -> {f x | x :e s :\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> {f x | x :e s} = {g x | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {f x | x :e s} = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: IMAGE_FSTCART_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {fstcart M x | x :e \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}} = if t = Empty then Empty else s

items.name: IMAGE_FST_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {x 0 | x :e s :*: t} = if t = Empty then Empty else s

items.name: IMAGE_I
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = s

items.name: IMAGE_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = s

items.name: IMAGE_IMP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} = s -> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: IMAGE_IMP_INJECTIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ {f x | x :e s} = t) -> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: IMAGE_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, exists t c= A, t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} /\ forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e Union s /\ (y :e Union s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y}} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS_SATURATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ g = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g :\: {s} -> {x :e A | f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t) -> {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e g}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS_SATURATED_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g c= Power A, forall s u c= A, ~ g = Empty /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e g -> t c= u) /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g :\: {s} -> {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t)) -> {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e g}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g c= Power A, {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}} c= {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e g}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e s :/\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_SATURATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e A | f x :e {f x | x :e s}} c= s \/ {x :e A | f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t -> {f x | x :e s :/\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_SATURATED_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t u c= A, {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e {f x | x :e s}} c= s /\ t c= u \/ {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t /\ s c= u -> {f x | x :e s :/\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s :/\: t} c= {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_PAIRED_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, B <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e D) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= C, {(f (p 0),g (p 1)) | p :e s :*: t} = {f x | x :e s} :*: {g x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_PRODUCT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {(fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}} = {f0 :e B :^: K | (forall i :e k, f0 i :e {x0 :e B | x0 :e {f i x1 | x1 :e s i}}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f0 i = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: IMAGE_PROJECTION_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall i :e K, {(fun x :e A :^: K => i i) x | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}} = if {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty then Empty else if i :e k then s i else {choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: IMAGE_REAL_OF_INT_UNIV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> x :e int

items.name: IMAGE_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t -> {(if x :e t then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) | x :e s} = {f x | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_SNDCART_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {sndcart M N x | x :e \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}} = if s = Empty then Empty else t

items.name: IMAGE_SND_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {x 1 | x :e s :*: t} = if s = Empty then Empty else t

items.name: IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t -> {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s :\/: t} = {f x | x :e s} :\/: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= Power A, {f x | x :e Union s} = Union {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_o
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {f (g x) | x :e s} = {f x | x :e {g x | x :e s}}

items.name: IMP_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, (True -> t <-> t) /\ ((t -> True <-> True) /\ ((False -> t <-> True) /\ ((t -> t <-> True) /\ (t -> False <-> ~ t))))

items.name: IMP_CONJ
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p /\ q -> r <-> p -> q -> r

items.name: IMP_CONJ_ALT
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p /\ q -> r <-> q -> p -> r

items.name: IMP_DEF
items.statement: forall p q:prop, p -> q <-> (p /\ q <-> p)

items.name: IMP_IMP
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p -> q -> r <-> p /\ q -> r

items.name: IN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= A, forall x :e A, x :e P <-> x :e P

items.name: INDEX_0
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_index p 0 = 0

items.name: INDEX_1
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_index p 1 = 0

items.name: INDEX_ADD
items.statement: forall p n m :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (~ m = 0 -> prime_index p n < prime_index p m) -> prime_index p (m + n) = prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_ADD_MIN
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, (if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p m else prime_index p n) <= prime_index p (m + n)

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, exists m :e omega, p ^ prime_index p n * m = n /\ (n = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ ~ divides_nat p m))

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_LE
items.statement: forall p e1 m1 e2 m2 :e omega, p ^ e1 * m1 = p ^ e2 * m2 /\ (~ p = 0 /\ ~ divides_nat p m2) -> e1 <= e2

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_PRIME
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> exists m :e omega, p ^ prime_index p n * m = n /\ (n = 0 \/ gcd_int p m = 1)

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall p e1 m1 e2 m2 :e omega, p ^ e1 * m1 = p ^ e2 * m2 /\ (~ p = 0 /\ (~ divides_nat p m1 /\ ~ divides_nat p m2)) -> e1 = e2

items.name: INDEX_EQ_0
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_index p n = 0 <-> n = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ ~ divides_nat p n)

items.name: INDEX_EXP
items.statement: forall p n k :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (n ^ k) = k * prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_FACT
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial n) = finsum (idx_n n) (fun m:set => prime_index p m)

items.name: INDEX_FACT_ALT
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial n) = finsum {j :e omega | 1 <= j /\ p ^ j <= n} (fun j:set => div_nat n (p ^ j))

items.name: INDEX_FACT_PRIME_MULT
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial (p * n)) = n + prime_index p (factorial n)

items.name: INDEX_FACT_UNBOUNDED
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial n) = finsum {j :e omega | 1 <= j} (fun j:set => div_nat n (p ^ j))

items.name: INDEX_GCD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (gcd_int m n) = if m = 0 then prime_index p n else if n = 0 then prime_index p m else if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p m else prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_LCM
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (lcm_int m n) = if m = 0 \/ n = 0 then 0 else if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p n else prime_index p m

items.name: INDEX_LT
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, (~ n = 0 \/ ~ k = 0) /\ n < p ^ k -> prime_index p n < k

items.name: INDEX_MUL
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ m = 0 /\ ~ n = 0) -> prime_index p (m * n) = prime_index p m + prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_MULT_ADD
items.statement: (forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (p ^ k * m + n) = prime_index p n) /\ ((forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (m * p ^ k + n) = prime_index p n) /\ ((forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (n + m * p ^ k) = prime_index p n) /\ forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (n + p ^ k * m) = prime_index p n))

items.name: INDEX_MULT_BASE
items.statement: (forall p n :e omega, prime_index p (p * n) = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else prime_index p n + 1) /\ forall p n :e omega, prime_index p (n * p) = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else prime_index p n + 1

items.name: INDEX_MULT_EXP
items.statement: (forall p n k :e omega, prime_index p (p ^ k * n) = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else k + prime_index p n) /\ forall p n k :e omega, prime_index p (n * p ^ k) = if n = 0 \/ p <= 1 then 0 else prime_index p n + k

items.name: INDEX_NSUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p n :e omega, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (~ k = Empty /\ (forall a :e A, a :e k -> n <= prime_index p (f a))) -> n <= prime_index p (finsum k f)

items.name: INDEX_POW
items.statement: forall p n k :e omega, prime_index (p ^ k) n = div_nat (prime_index p n) k

items.name: INDEX_PRIME
items.statement: forall p a :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index a p = if p = a then 1 else 0

items.name: INDEX_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, prime_index n n = if n <= 1 then 0 else 1

items.name: INDEX_SUB_MIN
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, n < m -> (if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p m else prime_index p n) <= prime_index p (minus_nat m n)

items.name: INDEX_TRIVIAL_BOUND
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_index p n <= n

items.name: INDEX_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall p m n e0 :e omega, p ^ e0 * m = n /\ ((p = 0 -> e0 = 0) /\ ~ divides_nat p m) -> prime_index p n = e0

items.name: INDEX_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, prime_index p n = k <-> (p = 1 \/ n = 0 -> k = 0) /\ (~ (p = 1 \/ n = 0) -> divides_nat (p ^ k) n /\ ~ divides_nat (p ^ (k + 1)) n)

items.name: INDEX_UNIQUE_EQ
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, prime_index p n = k <-> (p = 1 \/ n = 0 -> k = 0) /\ (~ (p = 1 \/ n = 0) -> forall j :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ j) n <-> j <= k)

items.name: INDEX_ZERO
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, ~ divides_nat p n -> prime_index p n = 0

items.name: INDUCT_COPRIME
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall a b :e omega, 1 < a /\ (1 < b /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (P a /\ P b))) -> P (a * b)) /\ (forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> P (p ^ k)) -> forall n :e omega, 1 < n -> P n

items.name: INDUCT_COPRIME_ALT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ ((forall a b :e omega, 1 < a /\ (1 < b /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (P a /\ P b))) -> P (a * b)) /\ (forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> P (p ^ k))) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: INDUCT_COPRIME_STRONG
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall a b :e omega, 1 < a /\ (1 < b /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (P a /\ P b))) -> P (a * b)) /\ (forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ ~ k = 0 -> P (p ^ k)) -> forall n :e omega, 1 < n -> P n

items.name: INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> b <= inf s

items.name: INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> ~ finite s

items.name: INFINITE_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> atleastp omega s

items.name: INFINITE_CROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite (s :*: t) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ infinite t \/ infinite s /\ ~ t = Empty

items.name: INFINITE_CROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (infinite (A :*: B) <-> infinite A \/ infinite B)

items.name: INFINITE_DIFF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ finite t -> infinite (s :\: t)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ {r x | x :e omega} = s)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s <-> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ {r x | x :e omega} = s)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e omega, f x :e s) /\ forall x y :e omega, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: INFINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> infinite {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INFINITE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> infinite {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INFINITE_INTEGER
items.statement: infinite {x :e R | x :e int}

items.name: INFINITE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: INFINITE_RATIONAL
items.statement: infinite {x :e R | x :e rational}

items.name: INFINITE_RATIONAL_IN_RANGE
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> infinite {q :e R | q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)}

items.name: INFINITE_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ s c= t -> infinite t

items.name: INFINITE_UNIV_PAIR
items.statement: forall A:set, infinite (A :*: A) <-> infinite A

items.name: INF_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall c :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ inf s < c) -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c

items.name: INF_EQ
items.statement: forall s t c= R, (forall a :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x) <-> forall x :e R, x :e t -> a <= x) -> inf s = inf t

items.name: INF_EXISTS
items.statement: forall s c= R, (exists l :e R, is_glb s l) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x

items.name: INF_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> inf s :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x

items.name: INF_FINITE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, b :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x

items.name: INF_INSERT_FINITE
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, finite s -> inf (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= inf s then x else inf s

items.name: INF_INSERT_INSERT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, forall s c= R, inf (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s a) b) = inf (SetAdjoin s (if a <= b then a else b))

items.name: INF_LE_ELEMENT
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ a :e s -> inf s <= a

items.name: INF_SING
items.statement: forall a :e R, inf {a} = a

items.name: INF_UNION
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ (exists c :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> c <= x))) -> inf (s :\/: t) = if inf s <= inf t then inf s else inf t

items.name: INF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> c <= x) <-> c <= b) -> inf s = b

items.name: INF_UNIQUE_FINITE
items.statement: forall a :e R, forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (inf s = a <-> a :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> a <= y)

items.name: INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (inj s t f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y <-> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_EXP_MODULO
items.statement: forall n a b k :e omega, gcd_int k (totient n) = 1 /\ (gcd_int n a = 1 /\ (gcd_int n b = 1 /\ (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ k + n * q1 = b ^ k + n * q2))) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = b + n * q2

items.name: INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x)

items.name: INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t c= A, (exists x :e B, x :e s) -> ((forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ ((forall y :e A, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ forall x :e B, x :e s -> g (f x) = x))

items.name: INJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall l m :e finseq A, seq_map f l = seq_map f m -> l = m) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, P x /\ P y -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, (forall s t c= A, s c= u /\ (t c= u /\ {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t}) -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e u /\ (y :e u /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall u c= B, (forall t t' c= B, t c= u /\ (t' c= u /\ {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t'}) -> t = t') <-> u c= {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall t t' c= B, {x :e A | f x :e t} = {x :e A | f x :e t'} -> t = t') <-> {f x | x :e A} = B)

items.name: INJ_INVERSE2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y :e C) -> (forall x1 :e A, forall y1 :e B, forall x2 :e A, forall y2 :e B, P x1 y1 = P x2 y2 <-> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2) -> exists X:set -> set, (forall x :e C, X x :e A) /\ exists Y:set -> set, (forall x :e C, Y x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, forall y :e B, X (P x y) = x /\ Y (P x y) = y

items.name: INSEG_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m /\ inseg_on A m l -> forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0

items.name: INSEG_FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m -> fld_on A l c= fld_on A m

items.name: INSEG_LINSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> (inseg_on A m l <-> (forall x x0 :e A, m x x0 <-> l x x0) \/ exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ forall x x0 :e A, m x x0 <-> linseg_rel l a x x0)

items.name: INSEG_ORDINAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ ordinal_on A l -> ordinal_on A m

items.name: INSEG_PROPER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ ~ (forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0) -> exists x y :e A, l x y /\ ~ m x y

items.name: INSEG_PROPER_SUBSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ ~ (forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0) -> exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ ~ a :e fld_on A m

items.name: INSEG_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l l

items.name: INSEG_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l -> forall x y :e A, m x y -> l x y

items.name: INSEG_SUBSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A m -> x :e fld_on A l

items.name: INSEG_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m n:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m /\ inseg_on A m n -> inseg_on A l n

items.name: INSEG_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ woset_on A l -> woset_on A m

items.name: INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin s x = {y :e A | y :e s \/ y = x}

items.name: INSERT_AC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s y) x = SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) y /\ SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) x = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: INSERT_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s y) x = SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) y

items.name: INSERT_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, y :e SetAdjoin s x <-> y :e s \/ y = x

items.name: INSERT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e s -> SetAdjoin (s :\: {x}) x = s

items.name: INSERT_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, SetAdjoin s x :\: t = if x :e t then s :\: t else SetAdjoin (s :\: t) x

items.name: INSERT_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) x = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: INSERT_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :/\: t = if x :e t then SetAdjoin (s :/\: t) x else s :/\: t

items.name: INSERT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, {x :e A | x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ P x} = if P a then SetAdjoin {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} a else {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x}

items.name: INSERT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x c= t <-> x :e t /\ s c= t

items.name: INSERT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :\/: t = if x :e t then s :\/: t else SetAdjoin (s :\/: t) x

items.name: INSERT_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :\/: t = SetAdjoin (s :\/: t) x

items.name: INSERT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, SetAdjoin A x = A

items.name: INTEGER_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x :e int <-> x :e int

items.name: INTEGER_ABS_MUL_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> (abs_SNo (x * y) = 1 <-> abs_SNo x = 1 /\ abs_SNo y = 1)

items.name: INTEGER_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + y :e int

items.name: INTEGER_ADD_EQ
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x :e int -> (x + y :e int <-> y :e int)) /\ forall x y :e R, y :e int -> (x + y :e int <-> x :e int)

items.name: INTEGER_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> (exists n :e omega, x = n) \/ exists n :e omega, x = - n

items.name: INTEGER_CLOSED
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, n :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + y :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + - y :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x * y :e int) /\ ((forall x :e R, forall r :e omega, x :e int -> x ^ r :e int) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> - x :e int) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> abs_SNo x :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> (if x <= y then y else x) :e int) /\ forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> (if x <= y then x else y) :e int)))))))

items.name: INTEGER_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m :/: n :e int <-> n = 0 \/ divides_nat n m

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + 1 <= y -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x <= n /\ n < y)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 <= abs_SNo (x + - y) -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x <= n /\ n < y \/ y <= n /\ n < x)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ABS_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 < abs_SNo (x + - y) -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x < n /\ n < y \/ y < n /\ n < x)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ALT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + 1 <= y -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x < n /\ n <= y)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + 1 < y -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x < n /\ n < y)

items.name: INTEGER_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x * y :e int

items.name: INTEGER_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x :e int <-> x :e int

items.name: INTEGER_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (x :e int <-> exists n :e omega, x = n)

items.name: INTEGER_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, x :e int -> x ^ n :e int

items.name: INTEGER_REAL_OF_INT
items.statement: forall x :e int, x :e int

items.name: INTEGER_ROUND
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e R, n :e int /\ abs_SNo (x + - n) <= 1 :/: 2

items.name: INTEGER_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + - y :e int

items.name: INTEGER_SUB_EQ
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x :e int -> (x + - y :e int <-> y :e int)) /\ forall x y :e R, y :e int -> (x + - y :e int <-> x :e int)

items.name: INTEGER_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e int) -> finsum s f :e int

items.name: INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = {x :e A | x :e s /\ x :e t}

items.name: INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall u c= A, u :e s -> x :e u}

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s)

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, P Empty -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P {s} /\ Q s -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q Q':set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (forall x c= A, Q x -> Q' x) -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q' c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: INTERS_0
items.statement: forall A:set, {x :e A | forall Y :e Empty, x :e Y} = A

items.name: INTERS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, {x :e A | forall Y :e {s}, x :e Y} = s

items.name: INTERS_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | forall Y :e {s,t}, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: INTERS_ANTIMONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f g c= Power A, g c= f -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} c= {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_ANTIMONO_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= Power A, (forall y c= A, y :e t -> exists x c= A, x :e s /\ x c= y) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} c= {x :e A | forall Y :e t, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = A <-> forall s c= A, s :e f -> s = A

items.name: INTERS_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall P:set -> prop, forall f :e Power B :^: A, {x :e B | forall Y :e {f x | x :e A, P x}, x :e Y} = {a :e B | forall x :e A, P x -> a :e f x}) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power C :^: B :^: A, {x :e C | forall Y :e (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}), x :e Y} = {a :e C | forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> a :e f x y}) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power D :^: C :^: B :^: A, {x :e D | forall Y :e (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {f x y z | z :e C, P x y z}), x :e Y} = {a :e D | forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, P x y z -> a :e f x y z})

items.name: INTERS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e Power B :^: A, forall s c= A, {x :e B | forall Y :e {f x | x :e s}, x :e Y} = {y :e B | forall x :e A, x :e s -> y :e f x}

items.name: INTERS_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e SetAdjoin u s, x :e Y} = s :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_IN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e f

items.name: INTERS_OVER_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (Power B) :^: A, forall s c= A, {x :e B | forall Y :e {Union (f x) | x :e A, x :e s}, x :e Y} = Union {{x :e B | forall Y :e {g x | x :e A, x :e s}, x :e Y} | g :e Power B :^: A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x :e f x}

items.name: INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ u = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, t :e u -> t c= s) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} c= s

items.name: INTERS_SUBSET_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= Power A, forall s c= A, (exists t c= A, t :e u /\ t c= s) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} c= s

items.name: INTERS_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e s :\/: t, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e t, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = A :\: Union {A :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}

items.name: INTER_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :/\: t :/\: u = s :/\: (t :/\: u)

items.name: INTER_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} :/\: {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s i :/\: t i}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: INTER_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = t :/\: s

items.name: INTER_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, (s :*: t) :/\: (s' :*: t') = s :/\: s' :*: t :/\: t'

items.name: INTER_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :/\: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s (p 0) :/\: t (p 0)}}

items.name: INTER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, Empty :/\: s = Empty) /\ forall s c= A, s :/\: Empty = Empty

items.name: INTER_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :/\: s = s

items.name: INTER_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = if f = Empty then s else {x :e A | forall Y :e {s :/\: t | t :e Power A, t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :/\: s = if f = Empty then s else {x :e A | forall Y :e {t :/\: s | t :e Power A, t :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: INTER_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :/\: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} = {i :e omega | (if m <= p then p else m) <= i /\ i <= if n <= q then n else q}

items.name: INTER_OVER_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :\/: t :/\: u = (s :\/: t) :/\: (s :\/: u)

items.name: INTER_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) = \/_ x :e s :/\: s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :/\: t'}

items.name: INTER_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :/\: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :/\: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}

items.name: INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s t c= A, s :/\: t c= s) /\ forall s t c= A, t :/\: s c= s

items.name: INTER_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall s c= Power A, forall t c= A, Union s :/\: t = Union {x :/\: t | x :e Power A, x :e s}) /\ forall s c= Power A, forall t c= A, t :/\: Union s = Union {t :/\: x | x :e Power A, x :e s}

items.name: INTER_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x y :e s :\/: t, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) -> Union s :/\: Union t = Union (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTER_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, A :/\: s = s) /\ forall s c= A, s :/\: A = s

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int 2 (m + n) <-> (divides_int 2 m <-> divides_int 2 n)

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_MUL
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int 2 (m * n) <-> divides_int 2 m \/ divides_int 2 n

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_POW
items.statement: forall n :e int, forall k :e omega, divides_int 2 (n ^ k) <-> divides_int 2 n /\ ~ k = 0

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_SUB
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int 2 (m + - n) <-> (divides_int 2 m <-> divides_int 2 n)

items.name: INT_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = if 0 <= x then x else - x

items.name: INT_ABS_0
items.statement: abs_SNo 0 = 0

items.name: INT_ABS_1
items.statement: abs_SNo 1 = 1

items.name: INT_ABS_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y d :e int, 0 < d /\ (x + - d < y /\ y < x + d) <-> abs_SNo (y + - x) < d

items.name: INT_ABS_BETWEEN1
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, x < z /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < z + - x -> y < z

items.name: INT_ABS_BETWEEN2
items.statement: forall x0 x y0 y :e int, x0 < y0 /\ (2 * abs_SNo (x + - x0) < y0 + - x0 /\ 2 * abs_SNo (y + - y0) < y0 + - x0) -> x < y

items.name: INT_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall x y d :e int, abs_SNo (x + - y) < d -> y < x + d

items.name: INT_ABS_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall x k :e int, abs_SNo x <= k <-> - k <= x /\ x <= k

items.name: INT_ABS_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e int, x = 0 \/ 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_CIRCLE
items.statement: forall x y h :e int, abs_SNo h < abs_SNo y + - abs_SNo x -> abs_SNo (x + h) < abs_SNo y

items.name: INT_ABS_GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e int, abs_SNo (gcd_int a b) = gcd_int a b

items.name: INT_ABS_LCM
items.statement: forall a b :e int, abs_SNo (lcm_int a b) = lcm_int a b

items.name: INT_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e int, x <= abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x * y) = abs_SNo x * abs_SNo y

items.name: INT_ABS_MUL_1
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x * y) = 1 <-> abs_SNo x = 1 /\ abs_SNo y = 1

items.name: INT_ABS_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo (- x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo n = n

items.name: INT_ABS_NZ
items.statement: forall x :e int, ~ x = 0 <-> 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_POS
items.statement: forall x :e int, 0 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_POW
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (x ^ n) = abs_SNo x ^ n

items.name: INT_ABS_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: INT_ABS_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: INT_ABS_SIGN
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x + - y) < y -> 0 < x

items.name: INT_ABS_SIGN2
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x + - y) < - y -> x < 0

items.name: INT_ABS_STILLNZ
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x + - y) < abs_SNo y -> ~ x = 0

items.name: INT_ABS_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x + - y) = abs_SNo (y + - x)

items.name: INT_ABS_SUB_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y) <= abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: INT_ABS_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo (x + y) <= abs_SNo x + abs_SNo y

items.name: INT_ABS_ZERO
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = 0 <-> x = 0

items.name: INT_ADD2_SUB2
items.statement: forall a b c d :e int, (a + b) + - (c + d) = (a + - c) + b + - d

items.name: INT_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, m + n = n + m /\ ((m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p)

items.name: INT_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, x + y + z = (x + y) + z

items.name: INT_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z

items.name: INT_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall x :e int, 0 + x = x

items.name: INT_ADD_LINV

items.name: INT_CONG_DIVIDES

items.name: INT_CONG_REFL

items.statement: forall a b n :e int, gcd_int a n = 1 /\ ~ (n = 0 /\ abs_SNo a = 1) -> exists x :e int, 0 <= x /\ divides_int n (a * x + - b)

items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall d a b :e int, divides_int (d ^ n) (a * b) /\ gcd_int d a = 1 -> divides_int (d ^ n) b

items.name: INT_COPRIME_POW_ODD

items.name: INT_COPRIME_PRIME

items.name: INT_POW_LE2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ x <= y -> x ^ n <= y ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_LE2_ODD

items.name: INT_POW_LE2_ODD_EQ

items.name: INT_POW_LE2_REV
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e int, ~ n = 0 /\ (0 <= y /\ x ^ n <= y ^ n) -> x <= y

items.name: INT_POW_LE_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x :e int, 1 <= x -> 1 <= x ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_LT
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 0 < x -> 0 < x ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_LT2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e int, ~ n = 0 /\ (0 <= x /\ x < y) -> x ^ n < y ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_LT2_ODD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e int, x < y /\ odd_nat n -> x ^ n < y ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_LT2_ODD_EQ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e int, odd_nat n -> (x ^ n < y ^ n <-> x < y)

items.name: INT_POW_LT2_REV
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e int, 0 <= y /\ x ^ n < y ^ n -> x < y

items.name: INT_POW_LT_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x :e int, ~ n = 0 /\ 1 < x -> 1 < x ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_MONO
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, forall x :e int, 1 <= x /\ m <= n -> x ^ m <= x ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, forall x :e int, 1 < x /\ m < n -> x ^ m < x ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e int, forall n :e omega, (x * y) ^ n = x ^ n * y ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_MUL_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, forall k :e omega, ~ m = 0 /\ m ^ k * n = p ^ k -> exists q :e int, n = q ^ k

items.name: INT_POW_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, (- x) ^ n = if even_nat n then x ^ n else - x ^ n

items.name: INT_POW_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e int, forall n:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, n x0 :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> x ^ finsum s n = finprod s (fun i:set => x ^ n i)

items.name: INT_POW_NZ
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, ~ x = 0 -> ~ x ^ n = 0

items.name: INT_POW_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 ^ n = 1

items.name: INT_POW_POW
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall m n :e omega, (x ^ m) ^ n = x ^ (m * n)

items.name: INT_POW_REM
items.statement: forall m :e int, forall n :e omega, forall p :e int, rem_int (rem_int m p ^ n) p = rem_int (m ^ n) p

items.name: INT_POW_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

items.name: INT_PRIMES_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite {p :e int | 1 < abs_SNo p /\ forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p}

items.name: INT_PRIME_0
items.statement: ~ (1 < abs_SNo 0 /\ forall x :e int, divides_int x 0 -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo 0)

items.name: INT_PRIME_1
items.statement: ~ (1 < abs_SNo 1 /\ forall x :e int, divides_int x 1 -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo 1)

items.name: INT_PRIME_2
items.statement: 1 < abs_SNo 2 /\ forall x :e int, divides_int x 2 -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo 2

items.name: INT_PRIME_ABS
items.statement: forall p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo (abs_SNo p) /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x (abs_SNo p) -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo (abs_SNo p)) <-> 1 < abs_SNo p /\ forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p

items.name: INT_PRIME_COPRIME
items.statement: forall x p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) -> divides_int p x \/ gcd_int p x = 1

items.name: INT_PRIME_COPRIME_CASES
items.statement: forall p a b :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int p a = 1 \/ gcd_int p b = 1

items.name: INT_PRIME_COPRIME_EQ
items.statement: forall p n :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) -> (gcd_int p n = 1 <-> ~ divides_int p n)

items.name: INT_PRIME_COPRIME_LT
items.statement: forall x p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ (0 < abs_SNo x /\ abs_SNo x < abs_SNo p) -> gcd_int x p = 1

items.name: INT_PRIME_DIVPOW
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall p x :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ divides_int p (x ^ n) -> divides_int p x

items.name: INT_PRIME_DIVPOW_N
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall p x :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ divides_int p (x ^ n) -> divides_int (p ^ n) (x ^ n)

items.name: INT_PRIME_DIVPROD
items.statement: forall p a b :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ divides_int p (a * b) -> divides_int p a \/ divides_int p b

items.name: INT_PRIME_DIVPROD_EQ
items.statement: forall p a b :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) -> (divides_int p (a * b) <-> divides_int p a \/ divides_int p b)

items.name: INT_PRIME_DIVPROD_POW
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall p a b :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ divides_int (p ^ n) (a * b)) -> divides_int (p ^ n) a \/ divides_int (p ^ n) b

items.name: INT_PRIME_FACTOR
items.statement: forall x :e int, ~ abs_SNo x = 1 -> exists p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ divides_int p x

items.name: INT_PRIME_FACTOR_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (P 1 /\ (P (- 1) /\ (forall p n :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ (~ n = 0 /\ P n) -> P (p * n)))) -> forall n :e int, P n

items.name: INT_PRIME_FACTOR_LT
items.statement: forall n m p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) /\ (~ n = 0 /\ n = p * m) -> abs_SNo m < abs_SNo n

items.name: INT_PRIME_GE_2
items.statement: forall p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) -> 2 <= abs_SNo p

items.name: INT_PRIME_IMP_NZ
items.statement: forall p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo p /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p) -> ~ p = 0

items.name: INT_PRIME_NEG
items.statement: forall p :e int, 1 < abs_SNo (- p) /\ (forall x :e int, divides_int x (- p) -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo (- p)) <-> 1 < abs_SNo p /\ forall x :e int, divides_int x p -> abs_SNo x = 1 \/ abs_SNo x = abs_SNo p

items.name: INT_REM_0
items.statement: forall m :e int, rem_int m 0 = m

items.name: INT_REM_1
items.statement: forall n :e int, rem_int n 1 = 0

items.name: INT_REM_2_CASES
items.statement: forall n :e int, rem_int n 2 = 0 \/ rem_int n 2 = 1

items.name: INT_REM_2_DIVIDES
items.statement: (forall n :e int, rem_int n 2 = 0 <-> divides_int 2 n) /\ forall n :e int, rem_int n 2 = 1 <-> ~ divides_int 2 n

items.name: INT_REM_2_EXPAND
items.statement: forall x :e int, rem_int x 2 = if divides_int 2 x then 0 else 1

items.name: INT_REM_2_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e int, rem_int (- x) 2 = rem_int x 2

items.name: INT_REM_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int m n = m + - div_int m n * n

items.name: INT_REM_EQ
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, rem_int m p = rem_int n p <-> divides_int p (m + - n)

items.name: INT_REM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int m n = 0 <-> divides_int n m

items.name: INT_REM_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int m n = m <-> n = 0 \/ 0 <= m /\ m < abs_SNo n

items.name: INT_REM_LE
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, (n = 0 \/ 0 <= m) /\ m <= p -> rem_int m n <= p

items.name: INT_REM_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int m n <= m <-> n = 0 \/ 0 <= m

items.name: INT_REM_LNEG
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int (- m) n = if rem_int m n = 0 then 0 else abs_SNo n + - rem_int m n

items.name: INT_REM_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e int, (~ n = 0 -> 0 <= m) /\ m < n -> rem_int m n = m

items.name: INT_REM_MOD_SELF
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int n (rem_int m n + - m)

items.name: INT_REM_MUL
items.statement: (forall m n :e int, rem_int (m * n) n = 0) /\ forall m n :e int, rem_int (m * n) m = 0

items.name: INT_REM_MUL_ADD
items.statement: (forall m n p :e int, rem_int (m * n + p) n = rem_int p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e int, rem_int (n * m + p) n = rem_int p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e int, rem_int (p + m * n) n = rem_int p n) /\ forall m n p :e int, rem_int (p + n * m) n = rem_int p n))

items.name: INT_REM_MUL_REM
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, 0 <= n -> rem_int m (n * p) = n * rem_int (div_int m n) p + rem_int m n

items.name: INT_REM_NEG2
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int (- m) (- n) = if rem_int m n = 0 then 0 else abs_SNo n + - rem_int m n

items.name: INT_REM_POS
items.statement: forall a b :e int, ~ b = 0 -> 0 <= rem_int a b

items.name: INT_REM_POS_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e int, 0 <= rem_int m n <-> n = 0 -> 0 <= m

items.name: INT_REM_RABS
items.statement: forall x y :e int, rem_int x (abs_SNo y) = rem_int x y

items.name: INT_REM_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e int, rem_int n n = 0

items.name: INT_REM_REM
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int (rem_int m n) n = rem_int m n

items.name: INT_REM_REM_LE
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, ~ n = 0 /\ abs_SNo n <= abs_SNo p -> rem_int (rem_int m n) p = rem_int m n

items.name: INT_REM_REM_MUL
items.statement: (forall m n p :e int, rem_int (rem_int m (n * p)) n = rem_int m n) /\ forall m n p :e int, rem_int (rem_int m (n * p)) p = rem_int m p

items.name: INT_REM_REM_POW_MIN
items.statement: forall x p :e int, forall m n :e omega, rem_int (rem_int x (p ^ m)) (p ^ n) = rem_int x (p ^ if m <= n then m else n)

items.name: INT_REM_RNEG
items.statement: forall m n :e int, rem_int m (- n) = rem_int m n

items.name: INT_REM_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e int, m = q * n + r /\ (0 <= r /\ r < abs_SNo n) -> rem_int m n = r

items.name: INT_REM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, rem_int m n = p <-> (n = 0 /\ m = p \/ 0 <= p /\ p < abs_SNo n) /\ divides_int n (m + - p)

items.name: INT_REM_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e int, rem_int 0 n = 0

items.name: INT_RNEG_UNIQ
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + y = 0 <-> y = - x

items.name: INT_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: INT_SGNS_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> (x = 0 <-> y = 0) /\ ((0 < x <-> 0 < y) /\ (x < 0 <-> y < 0))

items.name: INT_SGNS_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> (x = 0 -> y = 0) /\ ((0 < x -> 0 < y) /\ (x < 0 -> y < 0))

items.name: INT_SGN_0
items.statement: (if 0 < 0 then 1 else if 0 < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0

items.name: INT_SGN_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) * abs_SNo x = x

items.name: INT_SGN_ABS_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) * x = abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_SGN_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0 \/ ((if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 1 \/ (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = - 1)

items.name: INT_SGN_EQ
items.statement: (forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0 <-> x = 0) /\ ((forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 1 <-> 0 < x) /\ forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = - 1 <-> x < 0)

items.name: INT_SGN_EQ_INEQ
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> x = y \/ abs_SNo (x + - y) < if abs_SNo x <= abs_SNo y then abs_SNo y else abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_SGN_INEQS
items.statement: (forall x :e int, 0 <= (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 <= x) /\ ((forall x :e int, 0 < (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 < x) /\ ((forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <= 0 <-> x <= 0) /\ ((forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) < 0 <-> x < 0) /\ ((forall x :e int, 0 = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 = x) /\ ((forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <= 0 <-> x <= 0) /\ ((forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) < 0 <-> x < 0) /\ ((forall x :e int, 0 <= (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 <= x) /\ ((forall x :e int, 0 < (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) <-> 0 < x) /\ forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = 0 <-> x = 0))))))))

items.name: INT_SGN_INT_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0 then 1 else if (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: INT_SGN_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if 0 < x * y then 1 else if x * y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) * if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: INT_SGN_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < - x then 1 else if - x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = - if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: INT_SGN_POW
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, (if 0 < x ^ n then 1 else if x ^ n < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) ^ n

items.name: INT_SGN_POW_2
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x ^ 2 then 1 else if x ^ 2 < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: INT_SOS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 0 <-> x = 0 /\ y = 0

items.name: INT_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = x + - y

items.name: INT_SUB_0
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = 0 <-> x = y

items.name: INT_SUB_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y <= abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: INT_SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (x + - y) + y = x

items.name: INT_SUB_ADD2
items.statement: forall x y :e int, y + x + - y = x

items.name: INT_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, x * (y + - z) = x * y + - x * z

items.name: INT_SUB_LE
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x + - y <-> y <= x

items.name: INT_SUB_LNEG
items.statement: forall x y :e int, - x + - y = - (x + y)

items.name: INT_SUB_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 < x + - y <-> y < x

items.name: INT_SUB_LZERO
items.statement: forall x :e int, 0 + - x = - x

items.name: INT_SUB_NEG2
items.statement: forall x y :e int, - x + - - y = y + - x

items.name: INT_SUB_POW
items.statement: forall x y :e int, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> x ^ n + - y ^ n = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i * y ^ minus_nat (minus_nat n 1) i)

items.name: INT_SUB_POW_L1
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> 1 + - x ^ n = (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i)

items.name: INT_SUB_POW_R1
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> x ^ n + - 1 = (x + - 1) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i)

items.name: INT_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, (x + - y) * z = x * z + - y * z

items.name: INT_SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e int, x + - x = 0

items.name: INT_SUB_REM
items.statement: forall m n p :e int, rem_int (rem_int m p + - rem_int n p) p = rem_int (m + - n) p

items.name: INT_SUB_RNEG
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - - y = x + y

items.name: INT_SUB_RZERO
items.statement: forall x :e int, x + - 0 = x

items.name: INT_SUB_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (x + - y) + - x = - y

items.name: INT_SUB_SUB2
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - (x + - y) = y

items.name: INT_SUB_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e int, (a + - b) + b + - c = a + - c

items.name: INT_WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e int, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e int, x <= y -> P x y) -> forall x y :e int, P x y

items.name: INT_WLOG_LE_3
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e int, P x y z -> P y x z /\ P x z y) /\ (forall x y z :e int, x <= y /\ y <= z -> P x y z) -> forall x y z :e int, P x y z

items.name: INT_WLOG_LT
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e int, P x x) /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e int, x < y -> P x y)) -> forall x y :e int, P x y

items.name: INT_WOP
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e int, 0 <= x /\ P x) <-> exists x :e int, 0 <= x /\ (P x /\ forall y :e int, 0 <= y /\ P y -> x <= y)

items.name: INV
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall y :e B, forall x :e A, INV_rel R0 x y <-> R0 y x

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, inverse_mod n 1 = 1

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_BOUND
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, inverse_mod n x < n <-> 2 <= n

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_BOUND_LE
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, inverse_mod n a <= n <-> ~ n = 0

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_CONG
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) -> inverse_mod n x = inverse_mod n y

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_INVERSE_MOD
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, gcd_int n x = 1 /\ (1 <= x /\ x <= n) -> inverse_mod n (inverse_mod n x) = x

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_INVERSE_MOD_CONG
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, gcd_int n x = 1 -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, inverse_mod n (inverse_mod n x) + n * q1 = x + n * q2

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_INVERSION
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 -> m * inverse_mod n m + n * inverse_mod m n = m * n + 1

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_LMUL
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, gcd_int n x = 1 -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, inverse_mod n x * x + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_LMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, inverse_mod n x * x + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) <-> gcd_int n x = 1

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_LMUL_GEN
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, exists q1 q2 :e omega, inverse_mod n x * x + n * q1 = gcd_int n x + n * q2

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_NONZERO
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, gcd_int n a = 1 -> ~ inverse_mod n a = 0

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_NONZERO_ALT
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, ~ divides_nat n a -> ~ inverse_mod n a = 0

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_RMUL
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, gcd_int n x = 1 -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x * inverse_mod n x + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_RMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x * inverse_mod n x + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) <-> gcd_int n x = 1

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_RMUL_GEN
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, exists q1 q2 :e omega, x * inverse_mod n x + n * q1 = gcd_int n x + n * q2

items.name: INVERSE_MOD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall n a x :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a * x + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ (x <= n /\ ~ (n = 1 /\ x = 0)) -> inverse_mod n a = x

items.name: INVOLUTION_EVEN_FIXPOINTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e s /\ f (f x) = x) -> (even_nat (finite_cardinality {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = x}) <-> even_nat (finite_cardinality s))

items.name: INVOLUTION_EVEN_NOFIXPOINTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e s /\ (~ f x = x /\ f (f x) = x)) -> even_nat (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: IN_CARD_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, Inj0 x :e s :+: t <-> x :e s) /\ forall y :e B, Inj1 y :e s :+: t <-> y :e t

items.name: IN_CARD_MUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (x,y) :e s :*: t <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall x :e A :^: K, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> x i :e s i

items.name: IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (x,y) :e s :*: t <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: IN_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, x :e s :\: {y} <-> x :e s /\ ~ x = y

items.name: IN_DELETE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x x' :e A, (x :e s <-> x' :e s) <-> (x :e s :\: {x'} <-> x' :e s :\: {x})

items.name: IN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s :\: t <-> x :e s /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: IN_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> ~ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ x :e t

items.name: IN_ELIM_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, (a,b) :e (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, P x y}) <-> P a b

items.name: IN_ELIM_PASTECART_THM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A :^: idx M, forall b :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N a b :e (\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N, P x y}) <-> P a b

items.name: IN_ELIM_QUAD_THM
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, (forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, forall d :e D, (a,(b,(c,d))) :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, \/_ y :e C, {(w,(x,(y,z))) | z :e D, P w x y z}) <-> P a b c d) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, forall d :e D, ((a,b),(c,d)) :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, \/_ y :e C, {((w,x),(y,z)) | z :e D, P w x y z}) <-> P a b c d) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, forall d :e D, (((a,b),c),d) :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, \/_ y :e C, {(((w,x),y),z) | z :e D, P w x y z}) <-> P a b c d)

items.name: IN_ELIM_TRIPLE_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, (forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, (a,(b,c)) :e (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {(x,(y,z)) | z :e C, P x y z}) <-> P a b c) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, ((a,b),c) :e (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {((x,y),z) | z :e C, P x y z}) <-> P a b c

items.name: IN_EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x0 x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} <-> forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: IN_EXTENSIONAL_UNDEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f :e {x0 :e B :^: A | forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> x x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: IN_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> exists y :e A, l x y \/ l y x

items.name: IN_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, {x :e A | x :e s} = s

items.name: IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall y :e B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (y :e {f x | x :e s} <-> exists x :e A, y = f x /\ x :e s)

items.name: IN_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, x :e SetAdjoin s y <-> x = y \/ x :e s

items.name: IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t <-> x :e s /\ x :e t

items.name: IN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, forall x :e A, x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} <-> forall t c= A, t :e s -> x :e t

items.name: IN_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, p :e {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} <-> m <= p /\ p <= n

items.name: IN_NUMSEG_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m :e {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} <-> m <= n

items.name: IN_REST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)} <-> x :e s /\ ~ x = choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)

items.name: IN_SET_OF_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, x :e seq_set l <-> seq_mem x l

items.name: IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, x :e {y} <-> x = y

items.name: IN_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} <-> x :e s /\ ~ f x = neutral_of B op

items.name: IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s :\/: t <-> x :e s \/ x :e t

items.name: IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, forall x :e A, x :e Union s <-> exists t c= A, t :e s /\ x :e t

items.name: IN_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x :e A

items.name: IPRODUCT_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x)) = abs_SNo (finprod s f)

items.name: IPRODUCT_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e int) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m * finprod {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> (forall m :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * f (ordsucc n) else finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f * f n

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, P 1 /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: IPRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e int, forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => c) = c ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: IPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e int, forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => c) = c ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: IPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall c :e int, forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun x:set => c) = c ^ n

items.name: IPRODUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a * finprod (s :\: {a}) f = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e int, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finprod s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 1) = if a :e s then b else 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finprod s f = finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finprod s f = 0 <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = 0)

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> exists x :e omega, m <= x /\ (x <= n /\ f x = 0)

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 1) -> finprod s f = 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_1_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 1) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: IPRODUCT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= B, (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finprod {f x | x :e s} g = finprod s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: IPRODUCT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finprod s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= g x) -> finprod s f <= finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= 1) -> finprod s f <= 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> 0 <= f i /\ f i <= g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: IPRODUCT_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 1} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 1} -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_MUL_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: IPRODUCT_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality s * finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ n * finprod (idx_n n) f

items.name: IPRODUCT_OFFSET
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m p :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: IPRODUCT_ONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finprod s (fun n:set => 1) = 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) * f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 1 else finprod {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: IPRODUCT_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, R0 1 1 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e int, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: IPRODUCT_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e int, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: IPRODUCT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => if i :e s then f i else 1) = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finprod {i :e A | i :e s /\ P i} f = finprod s (fun i:set => if P i then f i else 1)

items.name: IPRODUCT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall x :e A, finprod {x} f = f x

items.name: IPRODUCT_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: IPRODUCT_SUPERSET
