items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 1) -> finprod v f = finprod u f

items.name: IPRODUCT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finprod {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} f = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finprod (s :\/: t) f = finprod s f * finprod t f

items.name: IPRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} c= s -> finprod s f = finprod A f

items.name: ISO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x :e B, f (g x) = x) /\ (forall y :e A, g (f y) = y) <-> (forall x :e B, f (g x) = x) /\ forall y :e A, g (f y) = y)

items.name: ISO_FUN
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A_) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e A_, f' x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e B_) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e B_, g' x :e B) -> (forall x :e A_, f (f' x) = x) /\ (forall y :e A, f' (f y) = y) /\ ((forall x :e B_, g (g' x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, g' (g y) = y)) -> (forall x :e B_ :^: A_, (fun h :e B :^: A => fun a' :e A_ => g (h (f' a'))) ((fun h :e B_ :^: A_ => fun a :e A => g' (h (f a))) x) = x) /\ forall y :e B :^: A, (fun h :e B_ :^: A_ => fun a :e A => g' (h (f a))) ((fun h :e B :^: A => fun a' :e A_ => g (h (f' a'))) y) = y

items.name: ISO_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall x :e A, x = x) /\ forall y :e A, y = y

items.name: ISO_USAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e B, f (g x) = x) /\ (forall y :e A, g (f y) = y) -> (forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x) <-> forall x :e B, P (g x)) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> exists x :e B, P (g x)) /\ forall a :e A, forall b :e B, a = g b <-> f a = b)

items.name: ISUM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun n:set => 0) = 0

items.name: ISUM_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finsum s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x))

items.name: ISUM_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall b :e int, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= b) -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: ISUM_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= g x) -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_ABS_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => abs_SNo (f i))

items.name: ISUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: ISUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: ISUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: ISUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall b :e int, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) -> finsum s f <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: ISUM_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall b :e int, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: ISUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall b :e int, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: ISUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f + finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g

items.name: ISUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finsum Empty f = 0) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e int) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finsum (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finsum s f else f x + finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m + finsum {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: ISUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> (forall m :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + f (ordsucc n) else finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: ISUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + f n

items.name: ISUM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, P 0 /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: ISUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: ISUM_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n p :e omega, 0 < n /\ (m <= n /\ n <= p + 1) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: ISUM_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: ISUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e int, forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun n:set => c) = finite_cardinality s * c

items.name: ISUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e int, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = minus_nat (n + 1) m * c

items.name: ISUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> finsum (s :\: {a}) f = finsum s f + - f a

items.name: ISUM_DELETE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s -> finsum (s :\: {a}) f = if a :e s then finsum s f + - f a else finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e int, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 0) = if a :e s then b else 0

items.name: ISUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finsum (s :\: t) f = finsum s f + - finsum t f

items.name: ISUM_DIFFS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k + - f (k + 1)) = if m <= n then f m + - f (n + 1) else 0

items.name: ISUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finsum s f = finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: ISUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: ISUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e int) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: ISUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e int) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: ISUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: ISUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = 0))) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: ISUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g = finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ISUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s g = finsum {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: ISUM_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= g (f x)) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g <= finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ISUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e int) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = 0) -> finsum {i x | x :e s} d = finsum s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: ISUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum (s :\/: t) f + finsum (s :/\: t) f

items.name: ISUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_ISUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e int) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum (t i) (x i)) = finsum (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: ISUM_ISUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun x:set => finsum {y :e B | y :e t /\ R0 x y} (f x)) = finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: ISUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_LE_INCLUDED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e B, i x :e A) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> 0 <= g y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ (i y = x /\ f x <= g y)))) -> finsum s f <= finsum t g

items.name: ISUM_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i <= g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: ISUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall c :e int, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => c * f x) = c * finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_MULTICOUNT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = k * finite_cardinality t

items.name: ISUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k j)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = finsum t k

items.name: ISUM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => - f x) = - finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: ISUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: ISUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k * (g k + - g (minus_nat k 1))) = if m <= n then (f (n + 1) * g n + - f m * g (minus_nat m 1)) + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => g k * (f (k + 1) + - f k)) else 0

items.name: ISUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k * (g (k + 1) + - g k)) = if m <= n then (f (n + 1) * g (n + 1) + - f m * g m) + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => g (k + 1) * (f (k + 1) + - f k)) else 0

items.name: ISUM_POS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall b :e int, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ finsum s f <= b) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b

items.name: ISUM_POS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ finsum s f = 0) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0

items.name: ISUM_POS_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> 0 <= f p) /\ finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 -> forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> f p = 0

items.name: ISUM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> (forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> 0 <= f p) -> 0 <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: ISUM_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, R0 0 0 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e int, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: ISUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e int, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: ISUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else 0) = finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else 0)

items.name: ISUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall c :e int, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => f x * c) = finsum s f * c

items.name: ISUM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall x :e A, finsum {x} f = f x

items.name: ISUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: ISUM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + - g x) = finsum s f + - finsum s g

items.name: ISUM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finite u /\ (finite v /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e u :\: v -> f x <= 0) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v :\: u -> 0 <= f x))) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: ISUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finite v /\ (u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v :\: u -> 0 <= f x)) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: ISUM_SUB_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + - g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: ISUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum v f = finsum u f

items.name: ISUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finsum {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} f = finsum s f

items.name: ISUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum t (f i)) = finsum t (fun j:set => finsum s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: ISUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e int) -> finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: ISUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: ISUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: ISUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (Union s) f = finsum s (fun t:set => finsum t f)

items.name: ISUM_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum u f

items.name: ISUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall u v c= A, finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum v f

items.name: ISUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: ISUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall u v c= A, finite u /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum u f

items.name: ISUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} c= s -> finsum s f = finsum A f

items.name: ISUM_ZERO_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ finsum s u = 0 -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> u i = 0) \/ exists j k :e A, j :e s /\ (u j < 0 /\ (k :e s /\ 0 < u k))

items.name: ITER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, (forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e A) -> iter_fun 0 f x = x) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e A) -> forall n :e omega, iter_fun (ordsucc n) f x = f (iter_fun n f x)

items.name: ITERATE_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> iterate_op B op s f = iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: ITERATE_CASES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> finite s -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = op (iterate_op B op {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f) (iterate_op B op {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g)

items.name: ITERATE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> iterate_op C op Empty f = neutral_of C op) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e B, forall s c= B, finite s -> iterate_op C op (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then iterate_op C op s f else op (f x) (iterate_op C op s f)

items.name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> iterate_op B op Empty f = neutral_of B op) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} -> iterate_op B op (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then iterate_op B op s f else op (f x) (iterate_op B op s f)

items.name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> (forall m :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else neutral_of A op) /\ forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then op (iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (f (ordsucc n)) else iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> iterate_op A op {i :e omega | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\ forall k :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} f = op (iterate_op A op {i :e omega | i <= k} f) (f (ordsucc k))

items.name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> iterate_op A op {i :e omega | i < 0} f = neutral_of A op /\ forall k :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} f = op (iterate_op A op {i :e omega | i < k} f) (f k)

items.name: ITERATE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall P:set -> prop, P (neutral_of B op) /\ (forall x y :e B, P x /\ P y -> P (op x y)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ f x = neutral_of B op -> P (f x)) -> P (iterate_op B op s f)

items.name: ITERATE_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x y :e B, P x /\ P y -> P (op x y)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> P (f x))) -> P (iterate_op B op s f)

items.name: ITERATE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> op (f a) (iterate_op B op (s :\: {a}) f) = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall s c= A, iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => if x = a then f x else neutral_of B op) = if a :e s then f a else neutral_of B op

items.name: ITERATE_DIFF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> op (iterate_op B op (s :\: t) f) (iterate_op B op t f) = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_DIFF_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of B op} c= {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} -> op (iterate_op B op (s :\: t) f) (iterate_op B op t f) = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> iterate_op B op s f = iterate_op B op s g

items.name: ITERATE_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> iterate_op C op s f = iterate_op C op t g

items.name: ITERATE_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> iterate_op C op s f = iterate_op C op t g

items.name: ITERATE_EQ_NEUTRAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = neutral_of B op) -> iterate_op B op s f = neutral_of B op

items.name: ITERATE_EXPAND_CASES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, iterate_op B op s f = if finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} then iterate_op B op {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} f else neutral_of B op

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall K:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, finite k /\ i :e k -> divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f) (f i)

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_DIVIDES_EQ
items.statement: forall K:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> (divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f) (f i) <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 0} \/ f i = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> finite k -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f = 0 <-> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_EQ_0_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f = 0 <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 0} -> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op C op s g = iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => iterate_op C op {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ f x = f y)) -> g (f x) = neutral_of C op) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ITERATE_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ finite t -> op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f) = op (iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f) (iterate_op B op (s :/\: t) f)

items.name: ITERATE_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_ITERATE_DIVISORS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e A) -> forall x :e omega, (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> iterate_op A op (idx_n x) (fun n:set => iterate_op A op {d :e omega | divides_nat d n} (f n)) = iterate_op A op (idx_n x) (fun n:set => iterate_op A op (idx_n (div_nat x n)) (fun k:set => f (k * n) n))

items.name: ITERATE_ITERATE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e C) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> iterate_op C op s (fun i:set => iterate_op C op (t i) (x i)) = iterate_op C op (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall n :e omega, finite k -> (divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) n <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> divides_nat (f i) n)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_DIVIDES_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall n :e omega, divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) n <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> divides_nat (f i) n

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> finite k -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 0 <-> exists j :e K, j :e k /\ f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_0_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 0 <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} /\ exists j :e K, j :e k /\ f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_1
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> finite k -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 1 <-> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 1)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_1_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 1 <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} -> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 1)

items.name: ITERATE_OP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_OP_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ finite {x :e s | g x <> neutral_of B op} -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_OVER_COPRIME
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall n k :e omega, (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) /\ (gcd_int k n = 1 /\ (forall x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) -> f x = f y)) -> iterate_op A op {d :e omega | gcd_int d n = 1 /\ d < n} (fun m:set => f (k * m)) = iterate_op A op {d :e omega | gcd_int d n = 1 /\ d < n} f

items.name: ITERATE_PAIR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => op (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))

items.name: ITERATE_REFLECT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then neutral_of A op else iterate_op A op {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: ITERATE_RELATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, R0 (neutral_of B op) (neutral_of B op) /\ (forall x1 y1 x2 y2 :e B, R0 x1 x2 /\ R0 y1 y2 -> R0 (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)) -> R0 (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x1 y1 x2 y2 :e B, R0 x1 x2 /\ R0 y1 y2 -> R0 (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x))) -> R0 (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> iterate_op B op {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else neutral_of B op)

items.name: ITERATE_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, iterate_op B op {x} f = f x

items.name: ITERATE_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = neutral_of B op) -> iterate_op B op v f = iterate_op B op u f

items.name: ITERATE_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, iterate_op B op {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} f = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> iterate_op C op s (fun i:set => iterate_op C op t (f i)) = iterate_op C op t (fun j:set => iterate_op C op s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: ITERATE_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f)

items.name: ITERATE_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ (finite {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} :/\: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of B op} = Empty) -> iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f)

items.name: ITERATE_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = neutral_of B op)) -> iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f)

items.name: ITERATE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of B op} c= s -> iterate_op B op s f = iterate_op B op A f

items.name: ITLIST

items.name: ITLIST_APPEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall a :e B, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_foldr f (seq_append l1 l2) a = seq_foldr f l1 (seq_foldr f l2 a)

items.name: ITLIST_EXTRA
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_foldr f (seq_append l (seq_cons a seq_nil)) b = seq_foldr f l (f a b)

items.name: ITSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, g x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> forall x0 :e B, f x x0 = g x x0) /\ ((forall x y :e A, forall s0 :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s0) = f y (f x s0)) /\ (forall x y :e A, forall s0 :e B, ~ x = y -> g x (g y s0) = g y (g x s0)))) -> set_foldr f s b = set_foldr g s b

items.name: LAMBDA_PAIR

items.name: LAMBDA_PAIR_THM

items.name: LAMBDA_TRIPLE_THM

items.name: LAMBDA_UNIQUE

items.name: LAST

items.name: LCM

items.name: LCM_EQ_1

items.name: LCM_EQ_MULT

items.name: LCM_EXP

items.name: LCM_GCD_DISTRIB

items.name: LCM_LE_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n <= m * n

items.name: LCM_LMUL

items.name: LCM_MULTIPLE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int b (a * b) = a * b

items.name: LCM_REFL

items.name: LCM_RMUL

items.name: LCM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall d m n :e omega, divides_nat m d /\ (divides_nat n d /\ (forall e0 :e omega, divides_nat m e0 /\ divides_nat n e0 -> divides_nat d e0)) <-> d = lcm_int m n

items.name: LDIV_LT_EQ

items.statement: forall a n :e omega, 2 <= n /\ ((exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ minus_nat n 1 + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ (forall m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < minus_nat n 1 -> ~ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ m + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2)) -> prime_nat n

items.name: MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> seq_map f seq_nil = seq_nil) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_map f (seq_cons h t) = seq_cons (f h) (seq_map f t)

items.name: MAP2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, forall h2 :e B, forall t2 :e finseq B, seq_map2 f seq_nil seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_map2 f (seq_cons h1 t1) (seq_cons h2 t2) = seq_cons (f h1 h2) (seq_map2 f t1 t2)

items.name: MAP2_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall l :e finseq B, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, seq_map2 f seq_nil l = seq_nil /\ seq_map2 f (seq_cons h1 t1) l = seq_cons (f h1 (seq_hd l)) (seq_map2 f t1 (seq_tl l))

items.name: MAP_APPEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_map f (seq_append l1 l2) = seq_append (seq_map f l1) (seq_map f l2)

items.name: MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_all (fun x:set => f x = g x) l -> seq_map f l = seq_map g l

items.name: MAP_EQ_ALL2
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_all2 (fun x:set => fun y:set => f x = f y) l m -> seq_map f l = seq_map f m

items.name: MAP_EQ_DEGEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> seq_all (fun x:set => f x = x) l -> seq_map f l = l

items.name: MAP_EQ_NIL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_map f l = seq_nil <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: MAP_FST_ZIP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l1 :e finseq A, forall l2 :e finseq B, seq_len l1 = seq_len l2 -> seq_map (fun x:set => x 0) (seq_zip l1 l2) = l1

items.name: MAP_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e finseq A, seq_map (fun x:set => x) x = x

items.name: MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_map (fun x:set => x) l = l

items.name: MAP_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall n :e omega, seq_map g (seq_mk n f) = seq_mk n (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: MAP_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_map f l) = seq_map f (seq_rev l)

items.name: MAP_SND_ZIP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l1 :e finseq A, forall l2 :e finseq B, seq_len l1 = seq_len l2 -> seq_map (fun x:set => x 1) (seq_zip l1 l2) = l2

items.name: MAP_o
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_map (fun x:set => g (f x)) l = seq_map g (seq_map f l)

items.name: MAX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then n else m) = if m <= n then n else m

items.name: MAX_LE_LCM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (m = 0 <-> n = 0) -> (if m <= n then n else m) <= lcm_int m n

items.name: MAX_LE_LCM_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then n else m) <= lcm_int m n <-> (m = 0 <-> n = 0)

items.name: MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e omega) -> forall x y :e A, m x < m y <-> m x < m y

items.name: MEASURE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e omega) -> ((forall y :e A, m y < m a -> m y < m b) <-> m a <= m b)

items.name: MEM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_mem x seq_nil <-> False) /\ (seq_mem x (seq_cons h t) <-> x = h \/ seq_mem x t)

items.name: MEMBER_NOT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e s) <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: MEM_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_mem x (seq_append l1 l2) <-> seq_mem x l1 \/ seq_mem x l2

items.name: MEM_APPEND_DECOMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem x l <-> exists l1 l2 :e finseq A, l = seq_append l1 (seq_cons x l2)

items.name: MEM_APPEND_DECOMPOSE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem x l <-> exists l1 l2 :e finseq A, ~ seq_mem x l1 /\ l = seq_append l1 (seq_cons x l2)

items.name: MEM_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq (A :*: B), forall x :e A, seq_mem (x,seq_assoc x l) l <-> seq_mem x (seq_map (fun x0:set => x0 0) l)

items.name: MEM_EL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, n < seq_len l -> seq_mem (seq_nth l n) l

items.name: MEM_EXISTS_EL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, seq_mem x l <-> exists i :e omega, i < seq_len l /\ x = seq_nth l i

items.name: MEM_FILTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, seq_mem x (seq_filter P l) <-> P x /\ seq_mem x l

items.name: MEM_LIST_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, finite s -> forall x :e A, seq_mem x (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) <-> x :e s

items.name: MEM_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall y :e B, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem y (seq_map f l) <-> exists x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ y = f x

items.name: MEM_REPLICATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall x y :e A, seq_mem x (seq_replicate n y) <-> x = y /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: MIN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then m else n) = if m <= n then m else n

items.name: MINIMAL
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) <-> P (choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)) /\ forall m :e omega, m < choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) -> ~ P m

items.name: MINIMAL_BAD_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall bad:set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall x :e A :^: omega, ~ bad x -> exists n :e omega, forall y :e A :^: omega, (forall k :e omega, k < n -> y k = x k) -> ~ bad y) /\ (exists x :e A :^: omega, bad x)) -> exists y :e A :^: omega, bad y /\ forall z :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, bad z /\ (forall k :e omega, k < n -> z k = y k) -> ~ lt (z n) (y n)

items.name: MINIMAL_LBOUND
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) /\ (forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m) -> n <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)

items.name: MINIMAL_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) -> (choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <= n <-> exists i :e omega, i <= n /\ P i)

items.name: MINIMAL_MONO
items.statement: forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> Q n) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => Q n /\ forall m :e omega, Q m -> n <= m) <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)

items.name: MINIMAL_UBOUND
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P n -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <= n

items.name: MINIMAL_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P n /\ (forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) = n

items.name: MOD_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat 0 n = 0

items.name: MOD_1

items.name: MOD_2_CASES
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 2 = if even_nat n then 0 else 1

items.name: MOD_ADD_CASES
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m < p /\ n < p -> mod_nat (m + n) p = if m + n < p then m + n else minus_nat (m + n) p

items.name: MOD_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n -> mod_nat (x + y) n = mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n

items.name: MOD_ADD_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat (x + y) n = mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n <-> n = 0 \/ mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n

items.name: MOD_ADD_MOD
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat a n + mod_nat b n) n = mod_nat (a + b) n

items.name: MOD_CASES
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, n < 2 * p -> mod_nat n p = if n < p then n else minus_nat n p

items.name: MOD_DIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (mod_nat m n) n = 0

items.name: MOD_EQ
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m = n + q * p -> mod_nat m p = mod_nat n p

items.name: MOD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n = 0 <-> exists q :e omega, m = q * n

items.name: MOD_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n = m <-> n = 0 \/ m < n

items.name: MOD_EVEN_2
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> mod_nat (mod_nat m n) 2 = mod_nat m 2

items.name: MOD_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (exists q :e omega, m = n * q) <-> (n = 0 -> m = 0) /\ (~ n = 0 -> mod_nat m n = 0)

items.name: MOD_EXP
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> mod_nat (m ^ n) (m ^ p) = if p <= n \/ m = 1 then 0 else m ^ n

items.name: MOD_EXP_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n ^ p) n = mod_nat (m ^ p) n

items.name: MOD_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n <= m

items.name: MOD_LE_TWICE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, 0 < m /\ m <= n -> 2 * mod_nat n m <= n

items.name: MOD_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mod_nat m n = m

items.name: MOD_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n < n <-> ~ n = 0

items.name: MOD_LT_EQ_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n < n <-> 0 < n

items.name: MOD_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m (n * p)) n = mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MOD_EXP_MIN
items.statement: forall x p m n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat x (p ^ m)) (p ^ n) = mod_nat x (p ^ if m <= n then m else n)

items.name: MOD_MOD_LE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ n <= p -> mod_nat (mod_nat m n) p = mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MOD_REFL
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n) n = mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat (m * n) m = 0

items.name: MOD_MULT2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * n) (m * p) = m * mod_nat n p

items.name: MOD_MULT_ADD
items.statement: (forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * n + p) n = mod_nat p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (n * m + p) n = mod_nat p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (p + m * n) n = mod_nat p n) /\ forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (p + n * m) n = mod_nat p n))

items.name: MOD_MULT_CONG
items.statement: forall a b x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, mod_nat x (a * b) + a * q1 = y + a * q2) <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + a * q1 = y + a * q2

items.name: MOD_MULT_LMOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n * p) n = mod_nat (m * p) n

items.name: MOD_MULT_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat m (n * p) = n * mod_nat (div_nat m n) p + mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MULT_MOD2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n * mod_nat p n) n = mod_nat (m * p) n

items.name: MOD_MULT_RMOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * mod_nat p n) n = mod_nat (m * p) n

items.name: MOD_NSUM_MOD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> mod_nat (finsum s f) n = mod_nat (finsum s (fun i:set => mod_nat (f i) n)) n

items.name: MOD_NSUM_MOD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall a b n :e omega, mod_nat (finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} f) n = mod_nat (finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => mod_nat (f i) n)) n

items.name: MOD_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n n = 0

items.name: MOD_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> mod_nat m n = r

items.name: MOD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat m n = p <-> (n = 0 /\ m = p \/ p < n) /\ exists q1 q2 :e omega, m + n * q1 = p + n * q2

items.name: MOD_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 0 = n

items.name: MONOIDAL_AC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> (forall a :e A, op (neutral_of A op) a = a) /\ ((forall a :e A, op a (neutral_of A op) = a) /\ ((forall a b :e A, op a b = op b a) /\ ((forall a b c :e A, op (op a b) c = op a (op b c)) /\ forall a b c :e A, op a (op b c) = op b (op a c))))

items.name: MONOIDAL_ADD
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, x + y = y + x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, x + y + z = (x + y) + z) /\ forall x :e omega, neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) + x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_GCD
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, gcd_int x y = gcd_int y x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, gcd_int x (gcd_int y z) = gcd_int (gcd_int x y) z) /\ forall x :e omega, gcd_int (neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_INT_ADD
items.statement: (forall x y :e int, x + y = y + x) /\ (forall x y z :e int, x + y + z = (x + y) + z) /\ forall x :e int, neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) + x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_INT_MUL
items.statement: (forall x y :e int, x * y = y * x) /\ (forall x y z :e int, x * y * z = (x * y) * z) /\ forall x :e int, neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) * x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_LCM
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, lcm_int x y = lcm_int y x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, lcm_int x (lcm_int y z) = lcm_int (lcm_int x y) z) /\ forall x :e omega, lcm_int (neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_MUL
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, x * y = y * x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, x * y * z = (x * y) * z) /\ forall x :e omega, neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) * x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_REAL_ADD
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x + y = y + x) /\ (forall x y z :e R, x + y + z = (x + y) + z) /\ forall x :e R, neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) + x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_REAL_MUL
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x * y = y * x) /\ (forall x y z :e R, x * y * z = (x * y) * z) /\ forall x :e R, neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) * x = x

items.name: MONO_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q x) -> seq_all P l -> seq_all Q l

items.name: MONO_ALL2
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall l' :e finseq B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> Q x y) -> seq_all2 P l l' -> seq_all2 Q l l'

items.name: MONO_AND
items.statement: forall A B C D:prop, (A -> B) /\ (C -> D) -> A /\ C -> B /\ D

items.name: MONO_COND
items.statement: forall A B C D b:prop, (A -> B) /\ (C -> D) -> (b -> A) /\ (~ b -> C) -> (b -> B) /\ (~ b -> D)

items.name: MONO_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q x) -> (exists x :e A, P x) -> exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: MONO_FORALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q x) -> (forall x :e A, P x) -> forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: MONO_IMP
items.statement: forall B A C D:prop, (B -> A) /\ (C -> D) -> (A -> C) -> B -> D

items.name: MONO_NOT
items.statement: forall B A:prop, (B -> A) -> ~ A -> ~ B

items.name: MONO_OR
items.statement: forall A B C D:prop, (A -> B) /\ (C -> D) -> A \/ C -> B \/ D

items.name: MULT
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, 0 * n = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m * n = m * n + n

items.name: MULTIPLES_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat m d <-> divides_nat n d

items.name: MULT_0
items.statement: forall m :e omega, m * 0 = 0

items.name: MULT_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n

items.name: MULT_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * n = n * m /\ ((m * n) * p = m * n * p /\ m * n * p = n * m * p)

items.name: MULT_ASSOC

items.name: MULT_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, 0 * n = 0) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m * 0 = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 1 * n = n) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m * 1 = m) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m * n = m * n + n) /\ forall m n :e omega, m * ordsucc n = m + m * n))))

items.name: MULT_DIV
items.statement: (forall m n p :e omega, divides_nat p m -> div_nat (m * n) p = div_nat m p * n) /\ forall m n p :e omega, divides_nat p n -> div_nat (m * n) p = m * div_nat n p

items.name: MULT_DIV_LE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * div_nat n p <= div_nat (m * n) p

items.name: MULT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m * n = 0 <-> m = 0 \/ n = 0

items.name: MULT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m * n = 1 <-> m = 1 /\ n = 1

items.name: MULT_EXP
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, (m * n) ^ p = m ^ p * n ^ p

items.name: MULT_GCD_LCM

items.name: MULT_LCM_GCD

items.name: MULT_SUC

items.name: MULT_SYM

items.name: NEUTRAL_ADD

items.name: NEUTRAL_INT_ADD

items.name: NEUTRAL_INT_MUL

items.name: NEUTRAL_LCM

items.name: NONNEGATIVE_INTEGER

items.name: NONPOSITIVE_INTEGER

items.name: NONPOSITIVE_INTEGER_ALT

items.name: NOT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, ~ seq_all P l <-> seq_ex (fun x:set => ~ P x) l

items.name: NOT_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall t:prop, ~ ~ t <-> t) /\ ((~ True <-> False) /\ (~ False <-> True))

items.name: NOT_CLAUSES_WEAK
items.statement: (~ True <-> False) /\ (~ False <-> True)

items.name: NOT_CONS_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, ~ seq_cons h t = seq_nil

items.name: NOT_DEF
items.statement: forall p:prop, ~ p <-> p -> False

items.name: NOT_EMPTY_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ Empty = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: NOT_EQUAL_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, ~ s = t <-> exists x :e A, x :e t <-> ~ x :e s

items.name: NOT_EVEN
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ even_nat n <-> odd_nat n

items.name: NOT_EX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, ~ seq_ex P l <-> seq_all (fun x:set => ~ P x) l

items.name: NOT_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, ~ (exists x :e A, P x) <-> forall x :e A, ~ P x

items.name: NOT_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, ~ (forall x :e A, P x) <-> exists x :e A, ~ P x

items.name: NOT_IMP
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, ~ (t1 -> t2) <-> t1 /\ ~ t2

items.name: NOT_INSERT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ SetAdjoin s x = Empty

items.name: NOT_INT_REM_2
items.statement: (forall n :e int, ~ rem_int n 2 = 0 <-> rem_int n 2 = 1) /\ forall n :e int, ~ rem_int n 2 = 1 <-> rem_int n 2 = 0

items.name: NOT_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, ~ x :e Empty

items.name: NOT_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m <= n <-> n < m

items.name: NOT_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m < n <-> n <= m

items.name: NOT_ODD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ odd_nat n <-> even_nat n

items.name: NOT_PSUBSET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (s c= Empty /\ s <> Empty)

items.name: NOT_SUC
