items.error: internal constant NUMSUM (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: NUM_CASES_BINARY
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, P n) <-> (forall n :e omega, P (2 * n)) /\ forall n :e omega, P (2 * n + 1)

items.name: NUM_COUNTABLE
items.statement: countable omega

items.name: NUM_GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = gcd_int a b

items.name: NUM_LCM
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int a b = lcm_int a b

items.name: NUM_OF_INT
items.statement: forall x :e int, 0 <= x <-> (if x :e omega then x else 0) = x

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> (if x + y :e omega then x + y else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) + if y :e omega then y else 0

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> (if x * y :e omega then x * y else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) * if y :e omega then y else 0

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_OF_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, (if n :e omega then n else 0) = n

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_POW
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 0 <= x -> (if x ^ n :e omega then x ^ n else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) ^ n

items.name: ODD
items.statement: (odd_nat 0 <-> False) /\ forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc n) <-> ~ odd_nat n

items.name: ODD_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m + n) <-> ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)

items.name: ODD_DOUBLE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc (2 * n))

items.name: ODD_EXISTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> exists m :e omega, n = ordsucc (2 * m)

items.name: ODD_EXP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m ^ n) <-> odd_nat m \/ n = 0

items.name: ODD_MOD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> mod_nat n 2 = 1

items.name: ODD_MOD_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, n + 2 * q1 = 1 + 2 * q2

items.name: ODD_MOD_EVEN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> (odd_nat (mod_nat m n) <-> odd_nat m)

items.name: ODD_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m * n) <-> odd_nat m /\ odd_nat n

items.name: ODD_PHI_EQ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat (totient n) <-> n = 1 \/ n = 2

items.name: ODD_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (odd_nat p <-> 3 <= p)

items.name: ODD_SQUARE_MOD4
items.statement: forall n :e int, divides_int 4 ((2 * n + 1) ^ 2 + - 1)

items.name: ODD_SUB
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (minus_nat m n) <-> n < m /\ ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)

items.name: OEP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A p -> exists t:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A t /\ (fld_on A t = fld_on A p /\ forall x y :e A, p x y -> t x y)

items.name: ONE_ONE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x1 x2 :e A, f x1 = f x2 -> x1 = x2)

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat n p -> n = 1 \/ n = p

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME_DIVIDES_OR_COPRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1

items.name: ONTO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, y = f x)

items.name: ORDER
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ mult_order n a + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: ORDER_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mult_order n 1 = 1

items.name: ORDER_CONG
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = b + n * q2) -> mult_order n a = mult_order n b

items.name: ORDER_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall n a d :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ d + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) <-> divides_nat (mult_order n a) d

items.name: ORDER_DIVIDES_EXPDIFF
items.statement: forall a n d e0 :e omega, gcd_int n a = 1 -> ((exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ d + n * q1 = a ^ e0 + n * q2) <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, d + mult_order n a * q1 = e0 + mult_order n a * q2)

items.name: ORDER_DIVIDES_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall p :e omega, ~ p = 1 -> exists n :e omega, gcd_int p n = 1 /\ forall m :e omega, gcd_int p m = 1 -> divides_nat (mult_order p m) (mult_order p n)

items.name: ORDER_DIVIDES_PHI
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, gcd_int n a = 1 -> divides_nat (mult_order n a) (totient n)

items.name: ORDER_EQ_0
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, mult_order n a = 0 <-> ~ gcd_int n a = 1

items.name: ORDER_EQ_1
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, mult_order n a = 1 <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 :e Power A :^: A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall z :e A, forall k :e omega, finite {R0 (iter_fun n f z) | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (finite_cardinality {R0 (iter_fun n f z) | n :e omega, n :e omega} <= k /\ (R0 z z = 1 /\ ((forall x y :e A, R0 x y = 1 -> R0 y x = 1) /\ ((forall x y z0 :e A, R0 x y = 1 /\ R0 y z0 = 1 -> R0 x z0 = 1) /\ (forall x y :e A, R0 (f x) (f y) = 1 <-> R0 x y = 1))))) -> exists d :e omega, 0 < d /\ (d <= k /\ forall n :e omega, R0 (iter_fun n f z) z = 1 <-> divides_nat d n)

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 :e Power A :^: A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall z :e A, finite {R0 (iter_fun n f z) | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (R0 z z = 1 /\ ((forall x y :e A, R0 x y = 1 -> R0 y x = 1) /\ ((forall x y z0 :e A, R0 x y = 1 /\ R0 y z0 = 1 -> R0 x z0 = 1) /\ (forall x y :e A, R0 (f x) (f y) = 1 <-> R0 x y = 1)))) -> exists d :e omega, 0 < d /\ forall n :e omega, R0 (iter_fun n f z) z = 1 <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> P (f 0) /\ (forall m n :e omega, P (f m) /\ ~ m = 0 -> (P (f (m + n)) <-> P (f n))) -> exists d :e omega, forall n :e omega, P (f n) <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_ITER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall z :e A, R0 z z /\ ((forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> R0 y x) /\ ((forall x y z0 :e A, R0 x y /\ R0 y z0 -> R0 x z0) /\ (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> R0 (f x) (f y)))) -> exists d :e omega, forall n :e omega, R0 (iter_fun n f z) z <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: ORDER_EXP
items.statement: forall p a k :e omega, ~ k = 0 /\ divides_nat k (mult_order p a) -> mult_order p (a ^ k) = div_nat (mult_order p a) k

items.name: ORDER_EXP_GEN
items.statement: forall p a k :e omega, mult_order p (a ^ k) = if k = 0 then 1 else div_nat (mult_order p a) (gcd_int (mult_order p a) k)

items.name: ORDER_INVERSE_MOD
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, gcd_int n a = 1 -> mult_order n (inverse_mod n a) = mult_order n a

items.name: ORDER_LCM_EXISTS
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, exists c :e omega, mult_order p c = lcm_int (mult_order p a) (mult_order p b)

items.name: ORDER_LE_PHI
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> mult_order n a <= totient n

items.name: ORDER_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall n a m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < mult_order n a -> ~ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ m + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: ORDER_MOD
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, mult_order p (mod_nat n p) = mult_order p n

items.name: ORDER_MUL_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, divides_nat (mult_order p (a * b)) (mult_order p a * mult_order p b)

items.name: ORDER_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, gcd_int (mult_order p a) (mult_order p b) = 1 -> mult_order p (a * b) = mult_order p a * mult_order p b

items.name: ORDER_MUL_LCM
items.statement: forall m n a :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 -> mult_order (m * n) a = lcm_int (mult_order m a) (mult_order n a)

items.name: ORDER_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall n a k :e omega, 0 < k /\ ((exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ k + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ (forall m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < k -> ~ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ m + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2)) -> mult_order n a = k

items.name: ORDER_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall n a d :e omega, mult_order n a = d <-> forall k :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ k + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) <-> divides_nat d k

items.name: ORDER_UNIQUE_PRIME
items.statement: forall n a p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (mult_order n a = p <-> ~ (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ p + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2)

items.name: ORDER_WORKS
items.statement: forall n a :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ mult_order n a + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ forall m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < mult_order n a -> ~ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ m + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2

items.name: ORDINAL_CHAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> inseg_on A m l \/ inseg_on A l m

items.name: ORDINAL_CHAINED_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall k l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> inseg_on A k l /\ inseg_on A k m -> (forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> l x x0) \/ ((forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> m x x0) \/ exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ (a :e fld_on A m /\ ((forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> linseg_rel l a x x0) /\ forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> linseg_rel m a x x0)))

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (ordinal_on A m /\ fld_on A l c= fld_on A m) -> inseg_on A l m

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> (fld_on A l c= fld_on A m <-> inseg_on A l m)

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (ordinal_on A m /\ fld_on A l = fld_on A m) -> forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0

items.name: ORDINAL_IMP_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l -> woset_on A l

items.name: ORDINAL_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (exists x :e A, ~ x :e fld_on A l) -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => l x y \/ y = choose_in A (fun y0:set => ~ y0 :e fld_on A l) /\ (x :e fld_on A l \/ x = choose_in A (fun y0:set => ~ y0 :e fld_on A l)))

items.name: ORDINAL_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall l :e Power A :^: A, P l -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e l x)) -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ l x y = 1)

items.name: ORDINAL_UNION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, ordinal_on A l -> x :e fld_on A l -> x :e fld_on A (fun a:set => fun b:set => exists l0:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l0 /\ l0 a b)

items.name: ORDINAL_UP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l -> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l) \/ exists m:set -> set -> prop, exists x :e A, ordinal_on A m /\ (x :e fld_on A m /\ ~ x :e fld_on A l)

items.name: OR_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, (True \/ t <-> True) /\ ((t \/ True <-> True) /\ ((False \/ t <-> t) /\ ((t \/ False <-> t) /\ (t \/ t <-> t))))

items.name: OR_DEF
items.statement: forall p q:prop, p \/ q <-> forall r:prop, (p -> r) -> (q -> r) -> r

items.name: OR_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) \/ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P x \/ Q x

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ 1 < p -> exists n :e omega, exists q r :e R, q :e int /\ (r :e int /\ (q :/: p ^ n < x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)))

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 < p /\ 0 < x) -> exists n q r :e omega, q :/: p ^ n < x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS_LE
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 < p /\ 0 <= x) -> exists n q r :e omega, q :/: p ^ n <= x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)

items.name: PAIR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A :*: B, (x 0,x 1) = x

items.name: PAIRED_ETA_THM
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A :*: B, f (x 0,x 1) = f x) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f x :e D) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f (x 0,(x 1 0,x 1 1)) = f x) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f x :e E) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f (x 0,(x 1 0,(x 1 1 0,x 1 1 1))) = f x)

items.name: PAIRED_EXT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, l x y :e C) -> forall m:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, m x y :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, l x y = m x y) <-> forall x :e A, forall x0 :e B, l x x0 = m x x0)

items.name: PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_pairwise r seq_nil <-> True) /\ (seq_pairwise r (seq_cons h t) <-> seq_all (r h) t /\ seq_pairwise r t)

items.name: PAIRWISE_AND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R' x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y /\ R' x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall l m :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_append l m) <-> seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (seq_pairwise R0 m /\ forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ seq_mem y m -> R0 x y)

items.name: PAIRWISE_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall c c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e c -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> forall x y :e Union c, x <> y -> R0 x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e Empty, x <> y -> r x y) <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e {f x | x :e s}, x <> y -> r x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> ~ f x = f y -> r (f x) (f y))

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> P x y) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (P x y /\ ~ x = y)) -> Q x y) -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> Q x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMPLIES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ (seq_mem y l /\ R0 x y) -> R' x y) -> seq_pairwise R' l

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y /\ r y x) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT_SYMMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall y :e A, y :e s -> (r x y <-> r y x)) -> ((forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y)

items.name: PAIRWISE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_map f l) <-> seq_pairwise (fun x:set => fun y:set => R0 (f x) (f y)) l

items.name: PAIRWISE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y) /\ t c= s -> forall x y :e t, x <> y -> r x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall x0 y :e {x}, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x0 y0 z :e A, R0 x0 y0 /\ R0 y0 z -> R0 x0 z) -> (seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons x (seq_cons y l)) <-> R0 x y /\ seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons y l))

items.name: PAIRWISE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s :\/: t, x <> y -> R0 x y) <-> (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ ((forall x y :e t, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s :\: t /\ y :e t :\: s -> R0 x y /\ R0 y x)

items.name: PAIR_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, (x,y) = (a,b) <-> x = a /\ y = b

items.name: PAIR_EXISTS_THM
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: PAIR_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall p :e A :*: B, exists x :e A, exists y :e B, p = (x,y)

items.name: PASTECART_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall u :e A :^: idx M, forall v :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> pastecart M N u v i = u i) /\ forall u :e A :^: idx M, forall v :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, dimindex M + 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M + dimindex N -> pastecart M N u v i = v (minus_nat i (dimindex M))

items.name: PASTECART_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), x = y <-> fstcart M x = fstcart M y /\ sndcart M N x = sndcart M N y

items.name: PASTECART_FST_SND
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall z :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), pastecart M N (fstcart M z) (sndcart M N z) = z

items.name: PASTECART_INJ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, forall w :e A :^: idx M, forall z :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y = pastecart M N w z <-> x = w /\ y = z

items.name: PASTECART_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: PCROSS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :\: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :\: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :\: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :\: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Empty}) = Empty) /\ forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e Empty, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Empty

items.name: PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> (s = Empty \/ t = Empty) /\ (s' = Empty \/ t' = Empty) \/ s = s' /\ t = t'

items.name: PCROSS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ t = Empty

items.name: PCROSS_INTER
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :/\: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :/\: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :/\: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall f c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x :e A :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}}) = if f = Empty then \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e {x :e A :^: idx M | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = if f = Empty then \/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall g c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e {x :e A :^: idx M | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x :e A :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}}) = if f = Empty then {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e g}, x :e Y} else if g = Empty then {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}, x :e Y} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e (\/_ s :e Power (A :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), s :e f /\ t :e g}), x :e Y}

items.name: PCROSS_MONO
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, s c= s' /\ t c= t' -> (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= \/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}

items.name: PCROSS_SING
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, (\/_ x0 :e {x}, {pastecart M N x0 y0 | y0 :e {y}}) = {pastecart M N x y}

items.name: PCROSS_UNION
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :\/: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :\/: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :\/: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :\/: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall f c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Union f}) = Union {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e f}) /\ forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e Union f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Union {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}

items.name: PCROSS_UNIONS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall g c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e Union f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Union g}) = Union (\/_ s :e Power (A :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), s :e f /\ t :e g})

items.name: PHI_0
items.statement: totient 0 = 0

items.name: PHI_1
items.statement: totient 1 = 1

items.name: PHI_2
items.statement: totient 2 = 1

items.name: PHI_ALT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, totient n = finite_cardinality {m :e omega | gcd_int m n = 1 /\ m < n}

items.name: PHI_ANOTHER
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 1 -> totient n = finite_cardinality {m :e omega | 0 < m /\ (m < n /\ gcd_int m n = 1)}

items.name: PHI_EQ_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, totient n = 0 <-> n = 0

items.name: PHI_EQ_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, totient p = minus_nat p 1 <-> p = 0 \/ prime_nat p

items.name: PHI_FINITE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite {m :e omega | gcd_int m n = 1 /\ m < n}

items.name: PHI_LIMIT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, totient n <= n

items.name: PHI_LIMIT_COMPOSITE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ prime_nat n /\ (~ n = 0 /\ ~ n = 1) -> totient n < minus_nat n 1

items.name: PHI_LIMIT_STRONG
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 1 -> totient n <= minus_nat n 1

items.name: PHI_LOWERBOUND_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 <= n -> 1 <= totient n

items.name: PHI_LOWERBOUND_1_STRONG
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> 1 <= totient n

items.name: PHI_LOWERBOUND_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 3 <= n -> 2 <= totient n

items.name: PHI_MULTIPLICATIVE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> totient (a * b) = totient a * totient b

items.name: PHI_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> totient p = minus_nat p 1

items.name: PHI_PRIMEPOW
items.statement: forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> totient (p ^ k) = if k = 0 then 1 else minus_nat (p ^ k) (p ^ minus_nat k 1)

items.name: PHI_PRIMEPOW_ALT
items.statement: forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> totient (p ^ k) = if k = 0 then 1 else p ^ minus_nat k 1 * minus_nat p 1

items.name: PHI_PRIMEPOW_SUC
items.statement: forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> totient (p ^ (k + 1)) = minus_nat (p ^ (k + 1)) (p ^ k)

items.name: PHI_PRIME_EQ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, totient n = minus_nat n 1 /\ (~ n = 0 /\ ~ n = 1) <-> prime_nat n

items.name: POCKLINGTON
items.statement: forall a n q r :e omega, 2 <= n /\ (minus_nat n 1 = q * r /\ (n <= q ^ 2 /\ ((exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ minus_nat n 1 + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ (forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p q -> gcd_int (minus_nat (a ^ div_nat (minus_nat n 1) p) 1) n = 1)))) -> prime_nat n

items.name: POCKLINGTON_ALT
items.statement: forall a n q r :e omega, 2 <= n /\ (minus_nat n 1 = q * r /\ (n <= q ^ 2 /\ ((exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ minus_nat n 1 + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ (forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p q -> exists b :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ div_nat (minus_nat n 1) p + n * q1 = b + n * q2) /\ gcd_int (minus_nat b 1) n = 1)))) -> prime_nat n

items.name: POCKLINGTON_LEMMA
items.statement: forall a n q r :e omega, 2 <= n /\ (minus_nat n 1 = q * r /\ ((exists q1 q2 :e omega, a ^ minus_nat n 1 + n * q1 = 1 + n * q2) /\ (forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p q -> gcd_int (minus_nat (a ^ div_nat (minus_nat n 1) p) 1) n = 1))) -> forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, p + q * q1 = 1 + q * q2

items.name: POCKLINGTON_PRIMEFACT
items.statement: forall n q r a b :e omega, forall ps :e finseq omega, 2 <= n /\ (q * r = minus_nat n 1 /\ n <= q * q) -> mod_nat (a ^ r) n = b -> seq_foldr (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x * x0) ps 1 = q -> mod_nat (b ^ q) n = 1 -> seq_all (fun p:set => prime_nat p /\ gcd_int (minus_nat (mod_nat (b ^ div_nat q p) n) 1) n = 1) ps -> prime_nat n

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_ADD
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x + q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_CONST
items.statement: forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => c)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_FINITE_ROOTS
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall a :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> (finite {x :e R | p x = a} <-> ~ forall x :e R, p x = a)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_I
items.statement: polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_ID
items.statement: polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P (fun x :e R => x) /\ ((forall c :e R, P (fun x :e R => c)) /\ ((forall p q :e R :^: R, P p /\ P q -> P (fun x :e R => p x + q x)) /\ (forall p q :e R :^: R, P p /\ P q -> P (fun x :e R => p x * q x)))) -> forall p :e R :^: R, polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x) -> P p

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_LMUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => c * p x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_MUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x * q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_NEG
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> (polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => - p x) <-> polynomial_function_R p)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_POW
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x ^ n)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R, forall y :e A, p x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x i)) -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => finprod s (p x))

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_RMUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x * c)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_SUB
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x + - q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R, forall y :e A, p x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x i)) -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => finsum s (p x))

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_o
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p (q x))

items.name: POSET_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: POSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: POSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: POSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, poset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ properly_rel l a x

items.name: POSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, poset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ properly_rel l x a

items.name: POSET_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: POSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: POSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, poset_on A l -> poset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: POSET_RESTRICTED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, poset_on (Power A) (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ x c= y))

items.name: POSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: POSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> poset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: POSET_num
items.statement: poset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: POWERSET_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> {s :e Power A | s c= Empty} = {Empty} /\ forall a :e A, forall t c= A, {s :e Power A | s c= SetAdjoin t a} = {s :e Power A | s c= t} :\/: {{x0 :e A | x0 :e SetAdjoin x a} | x :e {s :e Power A | s c= t}}

items.name: POWER_RESIDUE_MODULO_COPRIME
items.statement: forall n a k :e omega, gcd_int n a = 1 /\ gcd_int k (totient n) = 1 -> exists x q1 q2 :e omega, x ^ k + n * q1 = a + n * q2

items.name: POWER_RESIDUE_MODULO_PRIME
items.statement: forall p a k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ divides_nat p a /\ gcd_int k (minus_nat p 1) = 1) -> exists x q1 q2 :e omega, x ^ k + p * q1 = a + p * q2

items.name: POW_2_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (if 0 <= x ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x ^ 2)) = x

items.name: POW_2_SQRT_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x ^ 2)) = abs_SNo x

items.name: PRE
items.statement: nat_pred 0 = 0 /\ forall n :e omega, nat_pred (ordsucc n) = n

items.name: PRE_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P (nat_pred n) <-> forall m :e omega, n = ordsucc m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0 -> P m

items.name: PRE_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P (nat_pred n) <-> exists m :e omega, (n = ordsucc m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0) /\ P m

items.name: PRIMAFACT_CONTAINS
items.statement: forall ps :e finseq omega, forall n :e omega, seq_foldr (fun p:set => fun acc:set => p * acc) ps 1 = n /\ (forall p :e omega, seq_mem p ps -> prime_nat p) -> forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n -> seq_mem p ps

items.name: PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> ~ p = 0 /\ (~ p = 1 /\ forall m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < p -> gcd_int p m = 1)

items.name: PRIMEFACT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> exists ps :e finseq omega, seq_foldr (fun p:set => fun acc:set => p * acc) ps 1 = n /\ forall p :e omega, seq_mem p ps -> prime_nat p

items.name: PRIMEFACT_VARIANT
items.statement: forall ps :e finseq omega, forall n :e omega, seq_foldr (fun p:set => fun acc:set => p * acc) ps 1 = n /\ (forall p :e omega, seq_mem p ps -> prime_nat p) <-> seq_foldr (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x * x0) ps 1 = n /\ seq_all (fun x:set => prime_nat x) ps

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_FACT
items.statement: forall p n k :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ k) (factorial n) <-> k <= finsum {j :e omega | 1 <= j /\ p ^ j <= n} (fun j:set => div_nat n (p ^ j)))

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_INDEX
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ k) n <-> n = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ k <= prime_index p n)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p m :e omega, finite k /\ prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ m) (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> m = 0 \/ exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat (p ^ m) (f i))

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p m :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ m) (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> m = 0 \/ finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} /\ exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat (p ^ m) (f i))

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_LCM
items.statement: forall m n p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ k) (lcm_int m n) <-> divides_nat (p ^ k) m \/ divides_nat (p ^ k) n)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_PROD
items.statement: forall p k m n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) (m * n) -> exists i j :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ i) m /\ (divides_nat (p ^ j) n /\ k = i + j)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVISORS_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) m -> divides_nat (p ^ k) n

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVISORS_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ k) m <-> divides_nat (p ^ k) n)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_FACTOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 <= n -> exists p k m :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (1 <= k /\ (gcd_int p m = 1 /\ n = p ^ k * m))

items.name: PRIMES_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite {p :e omega | prime_nat p}

items.name: PRIME_0
items.statement: ~ prime_nat 0

items.name: PRIME_1
items.statement: ~ prime_nat 1

items.name: PRIME_2
items.statement: prime_nat 2

items.name: PRIME_ALT
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> ~ p = 0 /\ (~ p = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, 1 < n /\ n < p -> ~ divides_nat n p)

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> n = 1 \/ (divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1)

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_CASES
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int p a = 1 \/ gcd_int p b = 1

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_EQ
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> (gcd_int p n = 1 <-> ~ divides_nat p n)

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_EQ_NONDIVISIBLE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, gcd_int p n = 1 <-> ~ divides_nat p n

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_LT
items.statement: forall x p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (0 < x /\ x < p) -> gcd_int x p = 1

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_STRONG
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1

items.name: PRIME_DIVEXP
items.statement: forall n p x :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (x ^ n) -> divides_nat p x

items.name: PRIME_DIVEXP_EQ
items.statement: forall n p x :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (x ^ n) <-> divides_nat p x /\ ~ n = 0)

items.name: PRIME_DIVEXP_N
items.statement: forall n p x :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (x ^ n) -> divides_nat (p ^ n) (x ^ n)

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p :e omega, finite k /\ prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat p (f i))

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} /\ exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat p (f i))

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_LCM
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (lcm_int m n) <-> divides_nat p m \/ divides_nat p n)

items.name: PRIME_DIVISOR_SQRT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, prime_nat n <-> ~ n = 1 /\ forall d :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ d ^ 2 <= n -> d = 1

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (a * b) -> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_EQ
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (a * b) <-> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b)

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b)) -> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW_EQ
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ gcd_int a b = 1 -> (divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b) <-> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b)

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW_GEN
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ divides_nat p (gcd_int a b) /\ divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b)) -> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW_GEN_EQ
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ ~ divides_nat p (gcd_int a b) -> (divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b) <-> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b)

items.name: PRIME_EXP
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat (p ^ n) <-> prime_nat p /\ n = 1

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 1 -> exists p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n

items.name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finprod {p :e omega | prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n} (fun p:set => p ^ prime_index p n) = n

items.name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION_ALT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finprod {p :e omega | prime_nat p} (fun p:set => p ^ prime_index p n) = n

items.name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION_INDEX
items.statement: forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) -> finite {p :e omega | prime_nat p /\ ~ k p = 0} -> exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p n = k p

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (P 1 /\ (forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ n = 0 /\ P n) -> P (p * n))) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR_LT
items.statement: forall n m p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ n = 0 /\ n = p * m) -> m < n

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR_PARTITION
items.statement: forall Q:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> exists n1 n2 :e omega, n1 * n2 = n /\ ((forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n1 -> Q p) /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n2 -> ~ Q p)

items.name: PRIME_GE_2
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> 2 <= p

items.name: PRIME_IMP_NZ
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> ~ p = 0

items.name: PRIME_IMP_SQUAREFREE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall m :e omega, divides_nat (m ^ 2) p -> m = 1

items.name: PRIME_INT_DIVPROD_EQ
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall a b :e int, prime_nat p -> (divides_int p (a * b) <-> divides_int p a \/ divides_int p b)

items.name: PRIME_IRREDUCIBLE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> 1 < p /\ forall a b :e omega, divides_nat p (a * b) -> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b

items.name: PRIME_ODD
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> p = 2 \/ odd_nat p

items.name: PRIME_POWER_EXISTS
items.statement: forall n q :e omega, prime_nat q -> ((exists i :e omega, n = q ^ i) <-> forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n -> p = q)

items.name: PRIME_POWER_EXISTS_ALT
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> ((exists i :e omega, n = p ^ i) <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d n -> d = 1 \/ divides_nat p d)

items.name: PRIME_POWER_EXP
items.statement: forall n x p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ n = 0 /\ x ^ n = p ^ k) -> exists i :e omega, x = p ^ i

items.name: PRIME_POWER_MULT
items.statement: forall k x y p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ x * y = p ^ k -> exists i j :e omega, x = p ^ i /\ y = p ^ j

items.name: PRIME_PRIME_FACTOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, prime_nat n <-> ~ n = 1 /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n -> p = n

items.name: PRIME_PRIME_FACTOR_SQRT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, prime_nat n <-> ~ n = 0 /\ (~ n = 1 /\ ~ exists p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (divides_nat p n /\ p ^ 2 <= n))

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall n g :e omega, mult_order n g = totient n -> {mod_nat (g ^ i) n | i :e {i :e omega | i < totient n}} = {a :e omega | gcd_int a n = 1 /\ a < n}

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_IMAGE_PRIME
items.statement: forall p g :e omega, mult_order p g = minus_nat p 1 -> {mod_nat (g ^ i) p | i :e {i :e omega | i < minus_nat p 1}} = {a :e omega | 0 < a /\ a < p}

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_IMP_COPRIME
items.statement: forall n g :e omega, mult_order n g = totient n -> n = 0 \/ gcd_int n g = 1

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_IMP_PRIME
items.statement: forall p g :e omega, mult_order p g = minus_nat p 1 -> p = 0 \/ prime_nat p

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall n g a :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (mult_order n g = totient n /\ gcd_int a n = 1) -> exists m :e omega, m < totient n /\ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = g ^ m + n * q2

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_SURJECTIVE_ALT
items.statement: forall n g a :e omega, mult_order n g = totient n /\ gcd_int a n = 1 -> exists m q1 q2 :e omega, a + n * q1 = g ^ m + n * q2

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_SURJECTIVE_PRIME
items.statement: forall p g a :e omega, ~ p = 0 /\ (mult_order p g = minus_nat p 1 /\ gcd_int a p = 1) -> exists m :e omega, m < minus_nat p 1 /\ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + p * q1 = g ^ m + p * q2

items.name: PRIMITIVE_ROOT_SURJECTIVE_PRIME_ALT
items.statement: forall p g a :e omega, mult_order p g = minus_nat p 1 /\ gcd_int a p = 1 -> exists m q1 q2 :e omega, a + p * q1 = g ^ m + p * q2

items.name: PRODUCT_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x)) = abs_SNo (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e R) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m * finprod {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> (forall m :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * f (ordsucc n) else finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f * f n

items.name: PRODUCT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, P 1 /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => c) = c ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: PRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e R, forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => c) = c ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: PRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall c :e R, forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun x:set => c) = c ^ n

items.name: PRODUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a * finprod (s :\: {a}) f = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e R, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finprod s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 1) = if a :e s then b else 1

items.name: PRODUCT_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x :/: g x) = finprod s f :/: finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_DIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x :/: g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f :/: finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finprod s f = finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finprod s f = 0 <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = 0)

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> exists x :e omega, m <= x /\ (x <= n /\ f x = 0)

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 1) -> finprod s f = 1

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_1_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 1) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 1

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= B, (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finprod {f x | x :e s} g = finprod s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: PRODUCT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finprod s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => recip_SNo (f x)) = recip_SNo (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= g x) -> finprod s f <= finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= 1) -> finprod s f <= 1

items.name: PRODUCT_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> 0 <= f i /\ f i <= g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall k c= K, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e K, x x :e A) -> forall x0 :e K, (if x0 :e k then f x0 ((fun x1 :e K => if x1 :e k then x x1 else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: PRODUCT_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 1} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 1} -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_MUL_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality s * finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ n * finprod (idx_n n) f

items.name: PRODUCT_OFFSET
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m p :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: PRODUCT_ONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finprod s (fun n:set => 1) = 1

items.name: PRODUCT_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) * f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 1 else finprod {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: PRODUCT_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, R0 1 1 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: PRODUCT_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: PRODUCT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => if i :e s then f i else 1) = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finprod {i :e A | i :e s /\ P i} f = finprod s (fun i:set => if P i then f i else 1)

items.name: PRODUCT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall x :e A, finprod {x} f = f x

items.name: PRODUCT_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: PRODUCT_SPLIT_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finprod (idx_n (2 * n)) f = finprod (idx_n n) f * finprod {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= 2 * n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 1) -> finprod v f = finprod u f

items.name: PRODUCT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finprod {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} f = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finprod (s :\/: t) f = finprod s f * finprod t f

items.name: PRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} c= s -> finprod s f = finprod A f

items.name: PROPERLY_DIVIDES_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ (~ n = 0 /\ ~ m = n) -> 2 * m <= n

items.name: PROPERLY_EQ_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel l x x0 <-> strictly_rel l x x0

items.name: PROPERLY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 S:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> S x y) -> forall x y :e A, properly_rel R0 x y -> properly_rel S x y

items.name: PROPERLY_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel (properly_rel R0) x x0 <-> properly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: PROPERLY_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel (strictly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> s c= t /\ ~ s = t

items.name: PSUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> s c= t /\ exists a :e A, a :e t /\ ~ a :e s

items.name: PSUBSET_INSERT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> exists x :e A, ~ x :e s /\ SetAdjoin s x c= t

items.name: PSUBSET_IRREFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (s c= s /\ s <> s)

items.name: PSUBSET_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ t c= u -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: PSUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ (t c= u /\ t <> u) -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= Power A, (forall x y :e v, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (u c= v :\: {Empty} /\ u <> v :\: {Empty}) -> Union u c= Union v /\ Union u <> Union v

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, s c= A /\ s <> A <-> exists x :e A, ~ x :e s

items.name: QOSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> fld_on A l = {x :e A | l x x}

items.name: QOSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: QOSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, qoset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ strictly_rel l a x

items.name: QOSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, qoset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ strictly_rel l x a

items.name: QOSET_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= K, qoset_on (A :^: K) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (fun x :e A :^: K => {y :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, i :e s -> l (i i) (y i)}) x) <-> s = Empty \/ qoset_on A l

items.name: QOSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: QOSET_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, qoset_on A l -> (l x x <-> x :e fld_on A l)

items.name: QOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> qoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: QOSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: QOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> qoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: QOSET_num
items.statement: qoset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: RATIONAL_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> abs_SNo x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ABS_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational <-> exists p q :e omega, ~ q = 0 /\ abs_SNo x = p :/: q

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists r :e R, r :e rational /\ abs_SNo (r + - x) < e0

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_ABOVE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (x < q /\ q < x + e0)

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_BELOW
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (x + - e0 < q /\ q < x)

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists a b :e R, a :e rational /\ (b :e rational /\ (a < x /\ (x < b /\ abs_SNo (b + - a) < e0)))

items.name: RATIONAL_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)

items.name: RATIONAL_BETWEEN_EQ
items.statement: forall a b :e R, (exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)) <-> a < b

items.name: RATIONAL_CLOSED
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, n :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> x :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + - y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x * y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x :/: y :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, forall r :e omega, x :e rational -> x ^ r :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e rational -> - x :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e rational -> recip_SNo x :e rational) /\ forall x :e R, x :e rational -> abs_SNo x :e rational))))))))

items.name: RATIONAL_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x :/: y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int -> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> recip_SNo x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INV_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, recip_SNo x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x * y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> - x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, x :e rational -> x ^ n :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + - y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R) -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> x i :e rational) -> finsum s x :e rational

items.name: RAT_LEMMA1
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, ~ y1 = 0 /\ ~ y2 = 0 -> x1 :/: y1 + x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAT_LEMMA2
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, 0 < y1 /\ 0 < y2 -> x1 :/: y1 + x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAT_LEMMA3
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, 0 < y1 /\ 0 < y2 -> x1 :/: y1 + - x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + - x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RC_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall a0 a1 :e A, RC_rel R0 a0 a1 <-> R0 a0 a1 \/ a1 = a0

items.name: RC_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x x0 :e A, RC_rel R0 x x0 <-> R0 x x0) <-> forall x :e A, R0 x x

items.name: RC_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, RC_rel R0 x y <-> R0 x y \/ x = y

items.name: RC_IDEMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, RC_rel (RC_rel R0) x x0 <-> RC_rel R0 x x0

items.name: RC_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> RC_rel R0 x y

items.name: RC_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 RC':set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> RC' x y) /\ (forall x :e A, RC' x x) -> forall a0 a1 :e A, RC_rel R0 a0 a1 -> RC' a0 a1

items.name: RC_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, RC_rel (INV_rel R0) x x0 <-> INV_rel (RC_rel R0) x x0

items.name: RC_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 S:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> S x y) -> forall x y :e A, RC_rel R0 x y -> RC_rel S x y

items.name: RC_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, RC_rel R0 x x

items.name: RC_RULES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> RC_rel R0 x y) /\ forall x :e A, RC_rel R0 x x

items.name: RC_SC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, RC_rel (SC_rel R0) x x0 <-> SC_rel (RC_rel R0) x x0

items.name: RC_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> R0 y x) -> forall x y :e A, RC_rel R0 x y -> RC_rel R0 y x

items.name: RC_TC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, RC_rel (TC_on A R0) x x0 <-> TC_on A (RC_rel R0) x x0

items.name: RC_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e A, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) -> forall x y z :e A, RC_rel R0 x y /\ RC_rel R0 y z -> RC_rel R0 x z

items.name: RDIV_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (div_nat b a < n <-> b < a * n)

items.name: REAL_ABS_0
items.statement: abs_SNo 0 = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_1
items.statement: abs_SNo 1 = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y d :e R, 0 < d /\ (x + - d < y /\ y < x + d) <-> abs_SNo (y + - x) < d

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN1
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x < z /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < z + - x -> y < z

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN2
items.statement: forall x0 x y0 y :e R, x0 < y0 /\ (2 * abs_SNo (x + - x0) < y0 + - x0 /\ 2 * abs_SNo (y + - y0) < y0 + - x0) -> x < y

items.name: REAL_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall x y d :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < d -> y < x + d

items.name: REAL_ABS_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall x k :e R, abs_SNo x <= k <-> - k <= x /\ x <= k

items.name: REAL_ABS_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e R, x = 0 \/ 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_CIRCLE
items.statement: forall x y h :e R, abs_SNo h < abs_SNo y + - abs_SNo x -> abs_SNo (x + h) < abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x :/: y) = abs_SNo x :/: abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_INF_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (inf s) <= a

items.name: REAL_ABS_INTEGER_LEMMA
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ ~ x = 0 -> 1 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (recip_SNo x) = recip_SNo (abs_SNo x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, x <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE_SQRT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo ((if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) + - if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <= if 0 <= 2 * abs_SNo (x + - y) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (2 * abs_SNo (x + - y)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 2 * abs_SNo (x + - y))

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE_SQRT_POS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> abs_SNo ((if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) + - if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <= if 0 <= abs_SNo (x + - y) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo (x + - y)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo (x + - y))

items.name: REAL_ABS_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x * y) = abs_SNo x * abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (- x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo n = n

items.name: REAL_ABS_NZ
items.statement: forall x :e R, ~ x = 0 <-> 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (x ^ n) = abs_SNo x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ABS_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: REAL_ABS_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < y -> 0 < x

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < - y -> x < 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = if 0 <= abs_SNo x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_STILLNZ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < abs_SNo y -> ~ x = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) = abs_SNo (y + - x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y) <= abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (sup s) <= a

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + y) <= abs_SNo x + abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) <= z -> abs_SNo y <= z

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) < z -> abs_SNo y < z

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZERO
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = 0 <-> x = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZPOW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, abs_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = if 0 <= n then abs_SNo x ^ n else recip_SNo (abs_SNo x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ADD2_SUB2
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R, (a + b) + - (c + d) = (a + - c) + b + - d

items.name: REAL_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e R, m + n = n + m /\ ((m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p)

items.name: REAL_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x + y + z = (x + y) + z

items.name: REAL_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z

items.name: REAL_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 + x = x

items.name: REAL_ADD_LINV
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x + x = 0

items.name: REAL_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z

items.name: REAL_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + 0 = x

items.name: REAL_ADD_RINV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - x = 0

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + y) + - x = y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - (x + y) = - y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + y = y + x

items.name: REAL_ARCH
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < x -> forall y :e R, exists n :e omega, y < n * x

items.name: REAL_ARCH_INV
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 <-> exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (0 < recip_SNo n /\ recip_SNo n < e0)

items.name: REAL_ARCH_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 < x -> exists n :e omega, y < x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW2
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < 2 ^ n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW_INV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 < y /\ x < 1 -> exists n :e omega, x ^ n < y

items.name: REAL_ARCH_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x <= n

items.name: REAL_BINOMIAL_THEOREM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e R, (x + y) ^ n = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => binomial_coefficient n k * x ^ k * y ^ minus_nat n k)

items.name: REAL_BOUNDS_LE
items.statement: forall x k :e R, - k <= x /\ x <= k <-> abs_SNo x <= k

items.name: REAL_BOUNDS_LT

items.name: REAL_POW_LT

items.name: REAL_POW_LT2

items.name: REAL_POW_LT2_ODD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e R, x < y /\ odd_nat n -> x ^ n < y ^ n

items.name: REAL_POW_LT2_ODD_EQ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e R, odd_nat n -> (x ^ n < y ^ n <-> x < y)

items.name: REAL_POW_LT2_REV
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x y :e R, 0 <= y /\ x ^ n < y ^ n -> x < y

items.name: REAL_POW_LT_1

items.name: REAL_POW_MONO
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, forall x :e R, 1 <= x /\ m <= n -> x ^ m <= x ^ n

items.name: REAL_POW_MONO_INV
